# Canovaccio codice: Arctic Fuse 3 TMDbHelper -> Fen Light

Questo file sostituisce i tre repomix come base di lavoro ridotta.
Contiene codice reale estratto dai repomix, con numeri di linea relativi al file originale dentro il repomix.

Criteri:

- AF3: file completi per tutti i file che referenziano `plugin.video.themoviedb.helper`, `TMDbHelper`, `tmdbhelper` o `script-tmdbhelper`.
- Fen Light: entrypoint, router, helper URL, search, watched status, navigator, liste media, persone, random, dialog/extras, Trakt, metadati/settings e TMDb API.
- TMDbHelper: entrypoint, router, route table, window manager/direct call, recommendations, directory TMDb/Trakt, script methods, monitor service e factory per property/cast/crew/artwork/rating.
- Esclusi: `media/`, `fonts/`, `language/` e codice non utile al porting.

## Indice rapido

- `AF3_SOURCE_FULL`: codice skin da modificare o proteggere.
- `FENLIGHT_SOURCE_FULL`: codice Fen Light disponibile come target o da estendere.
- `TMDBHELPER_SOURCE_FULL`: codice TMDbHelper da cui derivare il comportamento da rimpiazzare.

## AF3_SOURCE_FULL

405 | def timeIt(func):
406 | 	# Thanks to 123Venom
407 | 	import time
408 | 	fnc_name = func.__name__
409 | 	def wrap(*args, **kwargs):
410 | 		started_at = time.time()
411 | 		result = func(*args, **kwargs)
412 | 		logger('%s.%s' % (__name__ , fnc_name), (time.time() - started_at))
413 | 		return result
414 | 	return wrap

422 | 		if int(100 - (float(string_alphanum_to_num(get_infolabel('Player.Volume').split('.')[0]))/60)*100) > max_volume: execute_builtin('SetVolume(%d)' % max_volume)

397 | 									SELECT media_id, season, episode, title, last_played FROM cte WHERE rn = 1''', ('episode',)).fetchall()
398 | 	else:

400 | 								('episode',)).fetchall()
401 | 	data = [{'media_ids': {'tmdb': int(i[0])}, 'season': int(i[1]), 'episode': int(i[2]), 'title': i[3], 'last_played': i[4]} for i in data]

405 | def get_next(season, episode, watched_info, season_data, nextep_content):
406 | 	if episode == 0: episode = 1
407 | 	elif nextep_content == 0:
408 | 		try:
409 | 			episode_count = next((i['episode_count'] for i in season_data if i['season_number'] == season), None)
410 | 			season = season if episode < episode_count else season + 1
411 | 			episode = episode + 1 if episode < episode_count else 1
412 | 		except: pass
413 | 	else:
414 | 		try:
415 | 			next_episode = 0
416 | 			relevant_seasons = [i for i in season_data if i['season_number'] >= season]
417 | 			for item in relevant_seasons:
418 | 				episode_count, item_season = item['episode_count'], item['season_number']
419 | 				if season == item_season:
420 | 					if episode >= episode_count:
421 | 						item_season, next_episode = None, None
422 | 						continue
423 | 					episode_range = range(episode + 1, episode_count + 1)
424 | 				else: episode_range = range(1, episode_count + 1)
425 | 				next_episode = next((i for i in episode_range if not get_watched_status_episode(watched_info, (item_season, i))), None)
426 | 				if next_episode: break
427 | 			if not next_episode: season, episode = None, None
428 | 			season, episode = item_season, next_episode
429 | 		except: pass
430 | 	return season, episode

467 | 		else: return episode_item['season_number'] == int(season_number) and episode_item['episode_number'] == int(episode_number)

477 | def movie_expiry(current_date, meta):
478 | 	try:
479 | 		difference = subtract_dates(current_date, jsondate_to_datetime(meta['premiered'], date_format, remove_time=True))
480 | 		if difference < 0: expiration = abs(difference) + 1
481 | 		elif difference <= 14: expiration = EXPIRES_7_DAYS
482 | 		elif difference <= 30: expiration = EXPIRES_14_DAYS
483 | 		elif difference <= 180: expiration = EXPIRES_30_DAYS
484 | 		else: expiration = EXPIRES_182_DAYS
485 | 	except: return EXPIRES_30_DAYS
486 | 	return max(expiration, EXPIRES_7_DAYS)
487 | 
488 | def tvshow_expiry(current_date, meta):
489 | 	try:
490 | 		if meta['status'] in finished_show_check: expiration = EXPIRES_182_DAYS
491 | 		else:
492 | 			data = subtract_dates(jsondate_to_datetime(meta['extra_info']['next_episode_to_air']['air_date'], date_format, remove_time=True), current_date) - EXPIRES_1_DAYS
493 | 			if data <= 1: expiration = EXPIRES_1_DAYS
494 | 			else: expiration = data*24
495 | 	except: expiration = EXPIRES_4_DAYS
496 | 	return expiration

136 | def seas_ep_filter(season, episode, release_title, split=False, return_match=False):
137 | 	str_season, str_episode = string(season), string(episode)
138 | 	season_fill, episode_fill = str_season.zfill(2), str_episode.zfill(2)
139 | 	str_ep_plus_1, str_ep_minus_1 = string(episode+1), string(episode-1)
140 | 	release_title = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9-]+', '.', unquote(release_title).replace('\'', '')).lower()
141 | 	string1 = r'(s<<S>>[.-]?e[p]?[.-]?<<E>>[.-])'
142 | 	string2 = r'(season[.-]?<<S>>[.-]?episode[.-]?<<E>>[.-])|([s]?<<S>>[x.]<<E>>[.-])'
143 | 	string3 = r'(s<<S>>e<<E1>>[.-]?e?<<E2>>[.-])'
144 | 	string4 = r'([.-]<<S>>[.-]?<<E>>[.-])'
145 | 	string5 = r'(episode[.-]?<<E>>[.-])'
146 | 	string6 = r'([.-]e[p]?[.-]?<<E>>[.-])'
147 | 	string7 = r'(^(?=.*\.e?0*<<E>>\.)(?:(?!((?:s|season)[.-]?\d+[.-x]?(?:ep?|episode)[.-]?\d+)|\d+x\d+).)*$)'
148 | 	string_list = []
149 | 	string_list_append = string_list.append
150 | 	string_list_append(string1.replace('<<S>>', season_fill).replace('<<E>>', episode_fill))
151 | 	string_list_append(string1.replace('<<S>>', str_season).replace('<<E>>', episode_fill))
152 | 	string_list_append(string1.replace('<<S>>', season_fill).replace('<<E>>', str_episode))
153 | 	string_list_append(string1.replace('<<S>>', str_season).replace('<<E>>', str_episode))
154 | 	string_list_append(string2.replace('<<S>>', season_fill).replace('<<E>>', episode_fill))
155 | 	string_list_append(string2.replace('<<S>>', str_season).replace('<<E>>', episode_fill))
156 | 	string_list_append(string2.replace('<<S>>', season_fill).replace('<<E>>', str_episode))
157 | 	string_list_append(string2.replace('<<S>>', str_season).replace('<<E>>', str_episode))
158 | 	string_list_append(string3.replace('<<S>>', season_fill).replace('<<E1>>', str_ep_minus_1.zfill(2)).replace('<<E2>>', episode_fill))
159 | 	string_list_append(string3.replace('<<S>>', season_fill).replace('<<E1>>', episode_fill).replace('<<E2>>', str_ep_plus_1.zfill(2)))
160 | 	string_list_append(string4.replace('<<S>>', season_fill).replace('<<E>>', episode_fill))
161 | 	string_list_append(string4.replace('<<S>>', str_season).replace('<<E>>', episode_fill))
162 | 	string_list_append(string5.replace('<<E>>', str_episode))
163 | 	string_list_append(string6.replace('<<E>>', episode_fill))
164 | 	string_list_append(string7.replace('<<E>>', episode_fill))
165 | 	final_string = '|'.join(string_list)
166 | 	reg_pattern = re.compile(final_string)
167 | 	if split: return release_title.split(re.search(reg_pattern, release_title).group(), 1)[1]
168 | 	if return_match: return re.search(reg_pattern, release_title).group()
169 | 	return bool(re.search(reg_pattern, release_title))

200 | 				release_title = re.sub(r'^%s' % pattern, '', release_title, 1, re.I)

202 | 		release_title = re.sub(r'^\[.*?]', '', release_title, 1, re.I)

212 | 			release_title = release_title.replace(year, '').replace('(', '').replace(')', '').replace('&', 'and').rstrip('.-').rstrip('.').rstrip('-').replace(':', '')
213 | 			if not any(release_title == i for i in cleaned_titles): return False
214 | 		else:

216 | 			if not any(i in release_title for i in cleaned_titles): return False
217 | 		return True

254 | 		if title == '': return None

330 | def get_cache_expiry(media_type, meta, season):
331 | 	try:
332 | 		current_date = get_datetime()
333 | 		if media_type == 'movie':
334 | 			premiered = jsondate_to_datetime(meta['premiered'], '%Y-%m-%d', remove_time=True)
335 | 			difference = subtract_dates(current_date, premiered)
336 | 			if difference == 0: single_expiry = expiry_3hrs
337 | 			elif difference <= 7: single_expiry = expiry_1day
338 | 			elif difference <= 14: single_expiry = expiry_2days
339 | 			elif difference <= 21: single_expiry = expiry_3days
340 | 			elif difference <= 30: single_expiry = expiry_4days
341 | 			elif difference <= 60: single_expiry = expiry_7days
342 | 			else: single_expiry = expiry_14days
343 | 			season_expiry, show_expiry = 0, 0
344 | 		else:
345 | 			recently_ended = False
346 | 			extra_info = meta['extra_info']
347 | 			ended = extra_info['status'] in ('Ended', 'Canceled')
348 | 			premiered = adjust_premiered_date(meta['premiered'], date_offset())[0]
349 | 			difference = subtract_dates(current_date, premiered)
350 | 			last_episode_to_air = jsondate_to_datetime(extra_info['last_episode_to_air']['air_date'], '%Y-%m-%d', remove_time=True)
351 | 			last_ep_difference = subtract_dates(current_date, last_episode_to_air)
352 | 			if ended and last_ep_difference <= 14: recently_ended = True
353 | 			if not ended or recently_ended:
354 | 				if difference == 0: single_expiry = expiry_3hrs
355 | 				elif difference <= 3: single_expiry = expiry_1day
356 | 				elif difference <= 7: single_expiry = expiry_3days
357 | 				else: single_expiry = expiry_7days
358 | 				if meta['total_seasons'] == season:
359 | 					if last_ep_difference <= 7: season_expiry = expiry_3days
360 | 					else: season_expiry = expiry_10days
361 | 				else: season_expiry = expiry_30days
362 | 				show_expiry = expiry_10days
363 | 			else: single_expiry, season_expiry, show_expiry = expiry_10days, expiry_30days, expiry_30days
364 | 	except: single_expiry, season_expiry, show_expiry = expiry_3days, expiry_3days, expiry_10days
365 | 	return single_expiry, season_expiry, show_expiry

### `plugin.video.fenlight:resources/lib/apis/tmdb_api.py`

`estrazione`: file completo. `motivo`: funzioni TMDb equivalenti: discover/search/recommendations/people/seasons.

```text

582 | 		function = tmdb_movies_reviews if media_type  == 'movie' else tmdb_tv_reviews

586 | 			all_data += data['results']
587 | 			total_pages = data['total_pages']
588 | 			next_page = data['page'] + 1

 58 | 			if method:
 59 | 				if method == 'post':
 60 | 					resp = session.post(API_ENDPOINT % path, headers=headers, timeout=timeout)
 61 | 				elif method == 'delete':
 62 | 					resp = session.delete(API_ENDPOINT % path, headers=headers, timeout=timeout)
 63 | 				elif method == 'sort_by_headers':
 64 | 					resp = session.get(API_ENDPOINT % path, params=params, headers=headers, timeout=timeout)
 65 | 			elif data is not None:
 66 | 				resp = session.post(API_ENDPOINT % path, json=data, headers=headers, timeout=timeout)
 67 | 			elif is_delete: resp = session.delete(API_ENDPOINT % path, headers=headers, timeout=timeout)
 68 | 			else: resp = session.get(API_ENDPOINT % path, params=params, headers=headers, timeout=timeout)
 69 | 			if resp.status_code not in (401, 429): resp.raise_for_status()
 70 | 		except Exception as e: return logger('Trakt Error', str(e))
 71 | 		return resp
 72 | 	if params is None: params = {}
 73 | 	CLIENT_ID = trakt_client()
 74 | 	if CLIENT_ID in empty_setting_check: return no_client_key()
 75 | 	headers = {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'trakt-api-version': '2', 'trakt-api-key': CLIENT_ID}
 76 | 	if pagination: params['page'] = page_no
 77 | 	response = send_query()
 78 | 	try: status_code = response.status_code
 79 | 	except: return None
 80 | 	if status_code == 401:
 81 | 		if not xbmc_player().isPlaying():
 82 | 			if with_auth and confirm_dialog(heading='Authorize Trakt', text='You must authenticate with Trakt. Do you want to authenticate now?') and trakt_authenticate():
 83 | 				response = send_query()
 84 | 			else: pass
 85 | 		else: return None
 86 | 	elif status_code == 429:
 87 | 		retry_headers = response.headers
 88 | 		if 'Retry-After' in retry_headers:
 89 | 			sleep(1000 * int(retry_headers.get('Retry-After', 5)))
 90 | 			response = send_query()
 91 | 	try:
 92 | 		response.encoding = 'utf-8'
 93 | 		result = response.json()
 94 | 	except: return None
 95 | 	resp_headers = response.headers
 96 | 	if method == 'sort_by_headers' and 'X-Sort-By' in resp_headers and 'X-Sort-How' in resp_headers:
 97 | 		try: result = sort_list(resp_headers['X-Sort-By'], resp_headers['X-Sort-How'], result)
 98 | 		except: pass
 99 | 	if pagination: return (result, resp_headers['X-Pagination-Page-Count'])
100 | 	else: return result

108 | def trakt_get_device_token(device_codes):
109 | 	CLIENT_ID = trakt_client()
110 | 	if CLIENT_ID in empty_setting_check: return no_client_key()
111 | 	CLIENT_SECRET = trakt_secret()
112 | 	if CLIENT_SECRET in empty_setting_check: return no_secret_key()
113 | 	result = None
114 | 	try:
115 | 		headers = {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'trakt-api-version': '2', 'trakt-api-key': CLIENT_ID}
116 | 		data = {'code': device_codes['device_code'], 'client_id': CLIENT_ID, 'client_secret': CLIENT_SECRET}
117 | 		start = time.time()
118 | 		expires_in = device_codes['expires_in']
119 | 		sleep_interval = device_codes['interval']
120 | 		user_code = str(device_codes['user_code'])
121 | 		try: copy2clip(user_code)
122 | 		except: pass
123 | 		content = '[CR]Navigate to: [B]%s[/B][CR]Enter the following code: [B]%s[/B]' % (str(device_codes['verification_url']), user_code)
124 | 		progressDialog = progress_dialog('Trakt Authorize', get_icon('trakt_qrcode'))
125 | 		progressDialog.update(content, 0)
126 | 		try:
127 | 			time_passed = 0
128 | 			while not progressDialog.iscanceled() and time_passed < expires_in:
129 | 				sleep(max(sleep_interval, 1)*1000)
130 | 				response = session.post(API_ENDPOINT % 'oauth/device/token', data=json.dumps(data), headers=headers, timeout=timeout)
131 | 				status_code = response.status_code
132 | 				if status_code == 200:
133 | 					result = response.json()
134 | 					break
135 | 				elif status_code == 400:
136 | 					time_passed = time.time() - start
137 | 					progress = int(100 * time_passed/expires_in)
138 | 					progressDialog.update(content, progress)
139 | 				else: break
140 | 		except: pass
141 | 		try: progressDialog.close()
142 | 		except: pass
143 | 	except: pass
144 | 	return result
145 | 
146 | def trakt_refresh_token():
147 | 	CLIENT_ID = trakt_client()
148 | 	if CLIENT_ID in empty_setting_check: return no_client_key()
149 | 	CLIENT_SECRET = trakt_secret()
150 | 	if CLIENT_SECRET in empty_setting_check: return no_secret_key()
151 | 	data = {        
152 | 		'client_id': CLIENT_ID, 'client_secret': CLIENT_SECRET, 'redirect_uri': 'urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob',
153 | 		'grant_type': 'refresh_token', 'refresh_token': get_setting('fenlight.trakt.refresh')}
154 | 	response = call_trakt("oauth/token", data=data, with_auth=False)
155 | 	if response and 'access_token' in response:
156 | 		set_setting('trakt.token', response["access_token"])
157 | 		set_setting('trakt.refresh', response["refresh_token"])
158 | 		set_setting('trakt.expires', str(time.time() + 7776000))

160 | def trakt_authenticate(dummy=''):
161 | 	code = trakt_get_device_code()
162 | 	token = trakt_get_device_token(code)
163 | 	if token:
164 | 		set_setting('trakt.token', token["access_token"])
165 | 		set_setting('trakt.refresh', token["refresh_token"])
166 | 		set_setting('trakt.expires', str(time.time() + 7776000))
167 | 		set_setting('watched_indicators', '1')
168 | 		sleep(1000)
169 | 		try:
170 | 			user = call_trakt('/users/me')
171 | 			set_setting('trakt.user', str(user['username']))
172 | 		except: pass
173 | 		notification('Trakt Account Authorized', 3000)
174 | 		trakt_sync_activities(force_update=True)
175 | 		return True
176 | 	notification('Trakt Error Authorizing', 3000)
177 | 	return False

184 | 	set_setting('watched_indicators', '0')
185 | 	clear_all_trakt_cache_data(silent=True, refresh=False)
186 | 	notification('Trakt Account Authorization Reset', 3000)

192 | 	response = call_trakt("oauth/revoke", data=data, with_auth=False)

296 | def trakt_watched_status_mark(action, media, media_id, tvdb_id=0, season=None, episode=None, key='tmdb'):
297 | 	if action == 'mark_as_watched': url, result_key = 'sync/history', 'added'
298 | 	else: url, result_key = 'sync/history/remove', 'deleted'
299 | 	if media == 'movies':
300 | 		success_key = 'movies'
301 | 		data = {'movies': [{'ids': {key: media_id}}]}
302 | 	else:
303 | 		success_key = 'episodes'
304 | 		if media == 'episode': data = {'shows': [{'seasons': [{'episodes': [{'number': int(episode)}], 'number': int(season)}], 'ids': {key: media_id}}]}
305 | 		elif media =='shows': data = {'shows': [{'ids': {key: media_id}}]}
306 | 		else: data = {'shows': [{'ids': {key: media_id}, 'seasons': [{'number': int(season)}]}]}#season
307 | 	result = call_trakt(url, data=data)
308 | 	success = result[result_key][success_key] > 0
309 | 	if not success:
310 | 		if media != 'movies' and tvdb_id != 0 and key != 'tvdb': return trakt_watched_status_mark(action, media, tvdb_id, 0, season, episode, 'tvdb')
311 | 	return success

374 | def trakt_fetch_collection_watchlist(list_type, media_type):
375 | 	def _process(params):
376 | 		data = get_trakt(params)
377 | 		if list_type == 'watchlist': data = [i for i in data if i['type'] == key]
378 | 		return [{'media_ids': {'tmdb': i[key]['ids'].get('tmdb', ''), 'imdb': i[key]['ids'].get('imdb', ''), 'tvdb': i[key]['ids'].get('tvdb', '')}, 'title': i[key]['title'],
379 | 				'collected_at': i.get(collected_at), 'released': i[key].get(r_key) if i[key].get(r_key) else ('2050-01-01' if media_type in ('movie', 'movies') else standby_date)}
380 | 				for i in data]
381 | 	key, r_key, string_insert = ('movie', 'released', 'movie') if media_type in ('movie', 'movies') else ('show', 'first_aired', 'tvshow')
382 | 	collected_at = 'listed_at' if list_type == 'watchlist' else 'collected_at' if media_type in ('movie', 'movies') else 'last_collected_at'
383 | 	string = 'trakt_%s_%s' % (list_type, string_insert)
384 | 	path = 'sync/%s/%s?extended=full'
385 | 	params = {'path': path, 'path_insert': (list_type, media_type), 'with_auth': True, 'pagination': False}
386 | 	return cache_trakt_object(_process, string, params)

724 | def trakt_progress_tv(progress_info):
725 | 	def _process_tmdb_ids(item):
726 | 		tmdb_id = get_trakt_tvshow_id(item['ids'])
727 | 		tmdb_list_append((tmdb_id, item['title']))
728 | 	def _process():
729 | 		for item in tmdb_list:
730 | 			try:
731 | 				tmdb_id = item[0]
732 | 				if not tmdb_id: continue
733 | 				title = item[1]
734 | 				try:
735 | 					from modules.metadata import tvshow_meta as _tm
736 | 					from modules.settings import mpaa_region as _mr
737 | 					_meta = _tm('tmdb_id', tmdb_id, tmdb_api_key(), _mr(), get_datetime())
738 | 					_ep_remap = _meta.get('tmdb_to_tvdb_ep', {}) if _meta else {}
739 | 				except: _ep_remap = {}
740 | 				for p_item in progress_items:
741 | 					if p_item['show']['title'] == title:
742 | 						season = p_item['episode']['season']
743 | 						ep_num = p_item['episode']['number']
744 | 						tvdb_s, tvdb_e = _ep_remap.get((season, ep_num), (season, ep_num))
745 | 						if tvdb_s > 0: yield ('episode', str(tmdb_id), tvdb_s, tvdb_e, str(round(p_item['progress'], 1)),
746 | 											0, p_item['paused_at'], p_item['id'], p_item['show']['title'])
747 | 			except: pass
748 | 	tmdb_list = []
749 | 	tmdb_list_append = tmdb_list.append
750 | 	progress_items = [i for i in progress_info if i['type'] == 'episode' and i['progress'] > 1]
751 | 	if not progress_items:
752 | 		trakt_watched_cache.set_bulk_tvshow_progress([])
753 | 		return
754 | 	all_shows = [i['show'] for i in progress_items]
755 | 	all_shows = [i for n, i in enumerate(all_shows) if not i in all_shows[n + 1:]] # remove duplicates
756 | 	threads = list(make_thread_list(_process_tmdb_ids, all_shows))
757 | 	[i.join() for i in threads]
758 | 	insert_list = list(_process())
759 | 	trakt_watched_cache.set_bulk_tvshow_progress(insert_list)

790 | def trakt_calendar_days(recently_aired, current_date):
791 | 	if recently_aired: start, finish = (current_date - timedelta(days=14)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d'), '14'
792 | 	else:
793 | 		previous_days = int(get_setting('fenlight.trakt.calendar_previous_days', '0'))
794 | 		future_days = int(get_setting('fenlight.trakt.calendar_future_days', '7'))
795 | 		start = (current_date - timedelta(days=previous_days)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
796 | 		finish = str(previous_days + future_days)
797 | 	return start, finish

799 | def make_trakt_slug(name):
800 | 	import re
801 | 	name = name.strip()
802 | 	name = name.lower()
803 | 	name = re.sub('[^a-z0-9_]', '-', name)
804 | 	name = re.sub('--+', '-', name)
805 | 	return name

816 | def trakt_sync_activities(force_update=False):
817 | 	# def clear_watched_tvshow_cache():
818 | 	# 	from modules.watched_status import clear_cache_watched_tvshow_status
819 | 	# 	clear_cache_watched_tvshow_status(watched_indicators=1)
820 | 	def clear_properties(media_type):
821 | 		for item in ((True, True), (True, False), (False, True), (False, False)): clear_property('1_%s_%s_%s_watched' % (media_type, item[0], item[1]))
822 | 	def _get_timestamp(date_time):
823 | 		return int(time.mktime(date_time.timetuple()))
824 | 	def _compare(latest, cached):
825 | 		try: result = _get_timestamp(js2date(latest, res_format)) > _get_timestamp(js2date(cached, res_format))
826 | 		except: result = True
827 | 		return result
828 | 	def _check_daily_expiry():
829 | 		return int(time.time()) >= int(get_setting('fenlight.trakt.next_daily_clear', '0'))
830 | 	if force_update: clear_all_trakt_cache_data(silent=True, refresh=False)
831 | 	elif _check_daily_expiry():
832 | 		clear_daily_cache()
833 | 		set_setting('trakt.next_daily_clear', str(int(time.time()) + (24*3600)))
834 | 	if not trakt_user_active() and not force_update: return 'no account'
835 | 	try: latest = trakt_get_activity()
836 | 	except: return 'failed'
837 | 	if not latest: return 'failed'
838 | 	cached = reset_activity(latest)
839 | 	if not _compare(latest['all'], cached['all']):
840 | 		if trakt_watched_cache.has_any_progress():

206 | 	def worker(self):
207 | 		self.current_date, self.current_time, self.watched_indicators = get_datetime(), get_current_timestamp(), watched_indicators()
208 | 		self.tmdb_api_key, self.mpaa_region = tmdb_api_key(), mpaa_region()
209 | 		self.watched_title = 'Trakt' if self.watched_indicators == 1 else 'Fen Light'
210 | 		watched_db = get_database(self.watched_indicators)
211 | 		self.watched_info, self.bookmarks = watched_info_movie(watched_db), get_bookmarks_movie(watched_db)
212 | 		self.window_command = 'ActivateWindow(Videos,%s,return)' if self.is_external else 'Container.Update(%s)'
213 | 		open_action = media_open_action('movie')
214 | 		self.open_movieset = open_action in (2, 3) and not self.movieset_list_active
215 | 		self.open_extras = open_action in (1, 3)
216 | 		if self.custom_order:
217 | 			threads = list(make_thread_list_multi_arg(self.build_movie_content, self.list))
218 | 			[i.join() for i in threads]
219 | 		else:
220 | 			threads = list(make_thread_list_enumerate(self.build_movie_content, self.list))
221 | 			[i.join() for i in threads]
222 | 			self.items.sort(key=lambda k: k[1])
223 | 			self.items = [i[0] for i in self.items]
224 | 		return self.items
225 | 
226 | 	def paginate_list(self, data, page_no):
227 | 		if paginate(self.is_home):
228 | 			limit = page_limit(self.is_home)
229 | 			data, total_pages = paginate_list(data, page_no, limit, self.paginate_start)
230 | 			if self.is_home: self.paginate_start = limit
231 | 		else: total_pages = 1
232 | 		return data, total_pages

 46 | def get_persistent_content(menu_type, key, remake_widgets, is_external):

 48 | 		clear_property(memory_str % menu_type)
 49 | 		return None, True
 50 | 	if not is_external: return None, False
 51 | 	try:
 52 | 		menu_type_content = json.loads(get_property(memory_str % menu_type))
 53 | 		cached_content = menu_type_content.get(key)
 54 | 		return cached_content, False
 55 | 	except:
 56 | 		clear_property(memory_str % menu_type)
 57 | 		return None, True

 61 | 	while get_property(memory_str % 'making_persistent_random_dict') == 'true': sleep(10)
 62 | 	set_property(memory_str % 'making_persistent_random_dict', 'true')
 63 | 	try: menu_type_content = json.loads(get_property(memory_str % menu_type))
 64 | 	except: menu_type_content = {}
 65 | 	menu_type_content[key] = data
 66 | 	set_property(memory_str % menu_type, json.dumps(menu_type_content))
 67 | 	clear_property(memory_str % 'making_persistent_random_dict')

361 | 				orig_button_dict[setting_id] = {'button_action': button_action, 'button_label': button_label, 'button_name': 'Button %s' % str(item - 9)}
362 | 	if media_type == None:

370 | 		choice = select_dialog(choices, **kwargs)

373 | 				for k, v in button_dict.items():
374 | 					set_setting(k, v['button_action'])
375 | 				return ok_dialog(text='Success')
376 | 			return
377 | 		media_type = choice[1]

382 | 					set_setting(item[0], item[1])

385 | 					set_setting(item[0], item[1])
386 | 			return ok_dialog(text='Success')
387 | 	choices = [('[B]%s[/B]   |   %s' % (v['button_name'], v['button_label']), v['button_name'], v['button_label'], k) for k, v in button_dict.items() if media_type in k]

399 | 	button_label, button_action = choice

477 | def favorites_choice(params):

527 | 	is_anime = params_get('is_anime') in (True, 'True', 'true')

529 | 	if not content: content = container_content()[:-1]

532 | 	if not meta:

534 | 		meta = function('tmdb_id', tmdb_id, tmdb_api_key(), mpaa_region(), get_datetime())
535 | 	meta_get = meta.get
536 | 	rootname, title, imdb_id, tvdb_id = meta_get('rootname', None), meta_get('title'), meta_get('imdb_id', None), meta_get('tvdb_id', None)
537 | 	window_function = activate_window if is_external else container_update
538 | 	listing = []
539 | 	listing_append = listing.append

204 | 		if use_result: total_pages = 1
205 | 		elif paginate_enabled:

208 | 			if is_home: paginate_start = limit
209 | 		else: total_pages = 1
210 | 		return data, total_pages, paginate_start
211 | 	handle, is_external, is_home, content, list_name = int(sys.argv[1]), external(), home(), 'movies', params.get('list_name')
212 | 	try:
213 | 		threads, item_list = [], []
214 | 		item_list_extend = item_list.extend
215 | 		user, slug, list_type = '', '', ''
216 | 		paginate_enabled = paginate(is_home)
217 | 		use_result = 'result' in params
218 | 		page_no, paginate_start = int(params.get('new_page', '1')), int(params.get('paginate_start', '0'))
219 | 		if page_no == 1 and not is_external: set_property('fenlight.exit_params', folder_path())
220 | 		if use_result: result = params.get('result', [])
221 | 		else:
222 | 			user, slug, list_type = params.get('user'), params.get('slug'), params.get('list_type')
223 | 			with_auth = list_type == 'my_lists'
224 | 			result = get_trakt_list_contents(list_type, user, slug, with_auth)
225 | 		process_list, total_pages, paginate_start = _paginate_list(result, page_no, paginate_start)
226 | 		all_movies = [i for i in process_list if i['type'] == 'movie']
227 | 		all_tvshows = [i for i in process_list if i['type'] == 'show']
228 | 		all_seasons = [i for i in process_list if i['type'] == 'season']
229 | 		all_episodes = [i for i in process_list if i['type'] == 'episode']

 2 | from jurialmunkey.parser import parse_paramstring, reconfigure_legacy_params
 3 | 
 4 | 
 5 | class Router():
 6 |     def __init__(self, handle, paramstring):
 7 |         # plugin:// params configuration
 8 |         self.handle = handle  # plugin:// handle
 9 |         self.paramstring, *secondary_params = paramstring.split('&&')  # plugin://plugin.video.themoviedb.helper?paramstring
10 |         self.params = reconfigure_legacy_params(**parse_paramstring(self.paramstring))  # paramstring dictionary
11 |         self.params.update(self.configure_paths(secondary_params))
12 | 
13 |     def configure_paths(self, secondary_params):
14 |         paths = [unquote_plus(self.params.pop(k)) for k in tuple(self.params.keys()) if k.startswith('paths')]
15 |         paths.extend([unquote_plus(i) for i in secondary_params])
16 |         return {'paths': paths} if paths else {}
17 | 
18 |     def play_player(self):
19 |         from tmdbhelper.lib.script.method.play_player import play_player
20 |         play_player(handle=self.handle if self.handle != -1 else None, **self.params)
21 | 
22 |     def get_directory(self, items_only=False, build_items=True):
23 |         from tmdbhelper.lib.items.routes import get_container
24 |         container = get_container(self.params.get('info'))(self.handle, self.paramstring, **self.params)
25 |         container.get_tmdb_id()  # TODO: Only get this as necessary
26 |         return container.get_directory(items_only, build_items)
27 | 
28 |     def run(self):
29 |         if self.params.get('info') == 'play':
30 |             return self.play_player()
31 |         self.get_directory()

103 |     def set_proptime(prop_name, v):
104 |         days, minutes = divmod(int(v), 60 * 24)
105 |         hour, minutes = divmod(int(minutes), 60)
106 |         get_property(f'{prop_name}_d', set_property=f'{days}')
107 |         get_property(f'{prop_name}_h', set_property=f'{hour}')
108 |         get_property(f'{prop_name}_mm', set_property=f'{minutes}')
109 | 
110 |     def set_property(base_name, stat_name, stat_type, v):
111 |         prop_name = f'{base_name}.{stat_type}.{stat_name}'
112 |         get_property(prop_name, set_property=f'{v}')
113 |         set_proptime(prop_name, v) if stat_name == 'minutes' else None
114 | 
115 |     def set_combined(stat_name, v):
116 |         stat_name = f'{stat_name}_total'
117 |         combined_stats.setdefault(stat_name, 0)
118 |         combined_stats[stat_name] += v
119 | 
120 |     def set_allstats(d, base_name, update_combined=True):
121 |         for k, v in d.items():
122 |             stat_name, stat_type = k.split('_')
123 |             set_property(base_name, stat_name, stat_type, v)
124 |             set_combined(stat_name, v) if update_combined else None
125 |

127 |     set_allstats(combined_stats, 'TraktStats', update_combined=False)

 33 | recommendations=list_id(int)|paramstring(str)|related(bool)|action(str)|close(str) [Separate multiples with || ]
 34 |     * The lists to add. Separate additional lists with ||

 48 | context=builtin(str)
 49 |     * The Kodi builtin to call oncontextmenu action
 50 |     * If ommitted then standard action for list will be performed
 51 | 
 52 | script-tmdbhelper-recommendations.xml
 53 | <onload>SetProperty(Action_{list_id},action)</onload>
 54 |     * Set an action for an undefined list
 55 | <onload>SetProperty(Close_{list_id},builtin)</onload>

 96 |         self._recommendations = {

 99 |         }

104 |         self._window_manager = kwargs['window_manager']

116 |         if self._initialised:

140 |     def _build_all_in_groups(self, x, list_id):
141 |         """ Build remaining queue in threaded groups of x items
142 |         PRO: Balances performance for displaying next list in queue and building all lists
143 |         CON: Queued lists might be added slightly out of order
144 |         """

228 |         listitems = [li.get_listitem(offscreen=True) for li in listitems if li]
229 |         return listitems
230 | 
231 |     def _add_items(self, list_id, listitems):
232 |         if not list_id or not listitems:
233 |             return
234 |         try:
235 |             _lst = self.getControl(list_id)
236 |         except (RuntimeError, TypeError):  # List with that ID doesn't exist so don't build it
237 |             return
238 |         _lst.addItems(listitems)
239 |         self.setProperty(PROP_LIST_VISIBLE.format(list_id), 'True')
240 |         return list_id

242 |     def build_list(self, list_id):
243 |         try:
244 |             self.getControl(list_id)
245 |         except (RuntimeError, TypeError):  # List with that ID doesn't exist so don't build it
246 |             return
247 | 
248 |         self.setProperty(PROP_LIST_ISUPDATING.format(list_id), 'True')
249 | 
250 |         affx = f'&tmdb_type={self._tmdb_type}&tmdb_id={self._tmdb_id}' if self._recommendations[list_id]['related'] else ''
251 |         path = f'{self._recommendations[list_id]["url"]}{affx}{self._tmdb_affix}'
252 | 
253 |         _listitems = self._get_items(path)
254 |         self.clearProperty(PROP_LIST_ISUPDATING.format(list_id))
255 |         return _listitems

257 | 
258 | class WindowRecommendationsManager():
259 |     def __init__(self, recommendations, window_id, **kwargs):
260 |         self._window_id = int(window_id) + 10000 if int(window_id) < 10000 else int(window_id)
261 |         self._recommendations = recommendations
262 |         self._kwargs = kwargs
263 |         self._gui = None
264 |         self._history = []
265 |         self._mon = Monitor()
266 |         self._current_path = None
267 |         self._current_dump = None
268 | 
269 |     def router(self):
270 |         if self._recommendations == 'onaction':
271 |             return self.on_exit(**self._kwargs)
272 |         if self._recommendations == 'onback':
273 |             return
274 |         if get_property(PROP_ISACTIVE):
275 |             return self.on_active()
276 |         with WindowProperty((PROP_ISACTIVE, 'True')):
277 |             self.on_info_new() if self._recommendations == 'oninfo' else self.open_recommendations()
278 | 
279 |     def wait_until_active(self, *args, **kwargs):
280 |         return wait_until_active(*args, xbmc_monitor=self._mon, **kwargs)
281 | 
282 |     def is_exiting(self):
283 |         if xbmcgui.getCurrentWindowId() != self._window_id:
284 |             return True
285 |         if get_property(PROP_ONCLOSED):
286 |             return True
287 |         return False
288 | 
289 |     def on_active(self):
290 |         if self.is_exiting():
291 |             return
292 |         self.dump_kwargs()
293 | 
294 |     def on_info_new(self):
295 |         _tmdb_type = self._kwargs['tmdb_type']
296 |         _tmdb_query = {i: self._kwargs[i] for i in TMDB_QUERY_PARAMS if self._kwargs.get(i)}
297 |         _tmdb_id = self._kwargs.get('tmdb_id') or FindQueriesDatabase().get_tmdb_id(tmdb_type=_tmdb_type, **_tmdb_query)
298 |         if not _tmdb_type or not _tmdb_id:
299 |             return
300 |         self.dump_kwargs(update_current_dump=True)
301 |         self.on_info(_tmdb_type, _tmdb_id)
302 | 
303 |     def dump_kwargs(self, update_current_dump=False):
304 |         from json import dumps
305 |         data = self._kwargs.copy()
306 |         data['recommendations'] = self._recommendations
307 |         data['window_id'] = self._window_id
308 |         data = dumps(data, separators=(',', ':'))
309 |         if update_current_dump:
310 |             self._current_dump = data
311 |         data = get_property(PROP_JSONDUMP, set_property=data)
312 |         return data
313 | 
314 |     def open_recommendations(self):
315 |         with BusyDialog():
316 |             self.dump_kwargs(update_current_dump=True)
317 |             self._gui = WindowRecommendations(
318 |                 'script-tmdbhelper-recommendations.xml', ADDONPATH, 'default', '1080i',
319 |                 recommendations=self._recommendations, window_id=self._window_id, window_manager=self, **self._kwargs)
320 |         self._gui.doModal()
321 |         return self._gui
322 | 
323 |     def on_join(self, t, path):
324 |         if self.is_exiting():
325 |             return self.on_exit()
326 | 
327 |         data = None
328 | 
329 |         # While INFO is active wait in loop until new action or we exit
330 |         while t.is_alive() and not self._mon.abortRequested():
331 | 
332 |             # If the action trigger changed lets do something
333 |             data = get_property(PROP_JSONDUMP)
334 |             if self._current_dump != data:
335 |                 break
336 |             data = None
337 | 
338 |             # We got an Exit command so we force quit out
339 |             if self.is_exiting():
340 |                 return self.on_exit()
341 | 
342 |             # We sit in a loop and poll ever 100ms
343 |             self._mon.waitForAbort(0.1)
344 | 
345 |         # Check that the currently active info dialog is the one we want to act
346 |         if self._current_path != path:
347 |             return
348 | 
349 |         if data:
350 |             from tmdbhelper.lib.files.futils import json_loads as loads
351 |             data = loads(data)
352 | 
353 |         # The trigger changed so lets open the recommendations window
354 |         if data and self._window_id == data.pop('window_id'):
355 |             self._recommendations = data.pop('recommendations')
356 |             self._kwargs = data
357 |             _gui = self._gui
358 |             data = self._current_dump
359 |             self.open_recommendations()
360 | 
361 |             # If RECS closed because ONBACK then we need to go back to the previous info and join it
362 |             if self._gui._state == 'onback':
363 |                 self._gui = _gui
364 |                 self._current_path = path
365 |                 return self.on_join(t, path)
366 | 
367 |         return self.on_back() if self._history and not self.is_exiting() else self.on_exit()
368 | 
369 |     def on_info(self, tmdb_type, tmdb_id, setproperty=None):
370 |         with BusyDialog():
371 |             listitem = self.get_listitem(tmdb_type, tmdb_id)
372 |             if not listitem:
373 |                 return
374 |             self._current_path = listitem.getPath()
375 | 
376 |         get_property(PROP_HIDEINFO, clear_property=True)
377 |         with WindowProperty((PROP_HIDERECS, 'True'), (setproperty, 'True')):
378 |             self.add_history()
379 |             t = self.open_info(listitem, self._gui.close if self._gui else None, threaded=True)
380 |             self.wait_until_active(ID_VIDEOINFO, poll=0.1)  # Wait to allow info dialog to open
381 | 
382 |         return self.on_join(t, listitem.getPath())
383 | 
384 |     def on_back(self, setproperty=None):
385 |         with BusyDialog():
386 |             listitem = self.get_listitem(**self.pop_history())
387 |             if not listitem:
388 |                 return self.on_exit()
389 |             self._current_path = listitem.getPath()
390 | 
391 |         get_property(PROP_HIDERECS, clear_property=True)
392 |         with WindowProperty((PROP_HIDEINFO, 'True'), (setproperty, 'True')):
393 |             get_property(PROP_TMDBTYPE, self._gui._tmdb_type)
394 |             t = self.open_info(listitem, threaded=True)
395 |             self.wait_until_active(ID_VIDEOINFO, poll=0.1)  # Wait to allow info dialog to open
396 |             self._gui.doModal()
397 | 
398 |         # Thread joins when Recs and Info close
399 |         return self.on_join(t, listitem.getPath())
400 | 
401 |     def pop_history(self):
402 |         try:
403 |             self._gui, meta, data = self._history.pop()
404 |             return meta
405 |         except IndexError:
406 |             return
407 | 
408 |     def add_history(self):
409 |         if not self._gui or not self._gui._tmdb_type or not self._gui._tmdb_id:
410 |             return
411 |         meta = {'tmdb_type': self._gui._tmdb_type, 'tmdb_id': self._gui._tmdb_id}
412 |         data = get_property(PROP_JSONDUMP)
413 |         self._history.append((self._gui, meta, data))
414 |         return meta
415 | 
416 |     def open_info(self, listitem, func=None, threaded=False):
417 |         executebuiltin(f'Dialog.Close(movieinformation,true)')
418 |         executebuiltin(f'Dialog.Close(pvrguideinfo,true)')
419 |         func() if func else None
420 |         if xbmcgui.getCurrentWindowId() != self._window_id:
421 |             executebuiltin(f'ActivateWindow({self._window_id})')
422 |             self.wait_until_active(self._window_id, poll=0.1)
423 |         self._current_dump = ''
424 |         get_property(PROP_JSONDUMP, clear_property=True)
425 |         if threaded:
426 |             t = SafeThread(target=xbmcgui.Dialog().info, args=[listitem])
427 |             t.start()
428 |             return t
429 |         xbmcgui.Dialog().info(listitem)
430 | 
431 |     @staticmethod
432 |     def get_listitem(tmdb_type, tmdb_id):
433 |         try:
434 |             _path = f"info=details&tmdb_type={tmdb_type}&tmdb_id={tmdb_id}"
435 |             return Router(-1, _path).get_directory(items_only=True)[0].get_listitem()
436 |         except (TypeError, IndexError, KeyError, AttributeError, NameError):
437 |             return
438 | 
439 |     def on_exit(self, builtin=None, after=False, **kwargs):
440 |         cond = self.is_exiting()
441 |         with WindowProperty((PROP_ONCLOSED, 'True')):
442 |             executebuiltin(builtin) if builtin and not after else None
443 |             executebuiltin(f'Dialog.Close(movieinformation,true)')
444 |             executebuiltin(f'Dialog.Close(pvrguideinfo,true)')
445 |             self.wait_until_active(ID_VIDEOINFO, invert=True, poll=0.1)
446 |             if not cond and xbmcgui.getCurrentWindowId() == self._window_id:
447 |                 _win = xbmcgui.Window(self._window_id)
448 |                 _win.close() if _win else None
449 |             self.wait_until_active(self._window_id, invert=True, poll=0.1)
450 |             executebuiltin(builtin) if builtin and after else None
451 |             for _gui, meta, data in self._history:
452 |                 del _gui
453 |             get_property(PROP_HIDEINFO, clear_property=True)
454 |             get_property(PROP_HIDERECS, clear_property=True)
455 |             get_property(PROP_TMDBTYPE, clear_property=True)
456 |             get_property(PROP_ISACTIVE, clear_property=True)
457 |             get_property(PROP_JSONDUMP, clear_property=True)

 1 | from tmdbhelper.lib.addon.plugin import get_setting
 2 | from jurialmunkey.window import get_property, wait_for_property
 3 | from tmdbhelper.lib.monitor.listitemtools import ListItemMonitorFunctions
 4 | from tmdbhelper.lib.monitor.cronjob import CronJobMonitor
 5 | from tmdbhelper.lib.monitor.player import PlayerMonitor
 6 | from tmdbhelper.lib.monitor.update import UpdateMonitor
 7 | from tmdbhelper.lib.monitor.imgmon import ImagesMonitor
 8 | from tmdbhelper.lib.monitor.poller import Poller, POLL_MIN_INCREMENT, POLL_MAX_INCREMENT
 9 | from tmdbhelper.lib.addon.thread import SafeThread

13 | class ServiceMonitor(Poller):
14 |     def __init__(self):
15 |         self.exit = False
16 |         self.listitem = None
17 | 
18 |     def run(self):
19 |         self.mutex_lock = Lock()
20 | 
21 |         self.update_monitor = UpdateMonitor()
22 |         self.player_monitor = PlayerMonitor()
23 | 
24 |         self.run_cron_job()
25 |         self.run_images_monitor()
26 | 
27 |         self.listitem_funcs = ListItemMonitorFunctions(self)
28 | 
29 |         get_property('ServiceStarted', 'True')
30 | 
31 |         self.poller()
32 | 
33 |     def run_cron_job(self):
34 |         self.cron_job = CronJobMonitor(self, update_hour=get_setting('library_autoupdate_hour', 'int'))
35 |         self.cron_job.setName('Cron Thread')
36 |         self.cron_job.start()
37 | 
38 |     def run_images_monitor(self):
39 |         self.images_monitor = ImagesMonitor(self)
40 |         self.images_monitor.setName('Image Thread')
41 |         self.images_monitor.start()
42 | 
43 |     def _on_listitem(self):
44 |         self.listitem_funcs.on_listitem()
45 |         self._on_idle(POLL_MIN_INCREMENT)
46 | 
47 |     def _on_scroll(self):
48 |         self.listitem_funcs.on_scroll()
49 |         self._on_idle(POLL_MIN_INCREMENT)
50 | 
51 |     def _on_fullscreen(self):
52 |         self.player_monitor.on_fullscreen()
53 |         self._on_idle(POLL_MAX_INCREMENT)
54 | 
55 |     def _on_context(self):
56 |         self.listitem_funcs.on_context_listitem()
57 |         self._on_idle(POLL_MIN_INCREMENT)
58 | 
59 |     def _on_clear(self):
60 |         """
61 |         IF we've got properties to clear lets clear them and then jump back in the loop
62 |         """
63 |         self.listitem_funcs.reset_current_item()  # Reset current item so that it will retrigger lookup on return to previous window
64 |         self.listitem_funcs.clear_properties()
65 |         self._on_idle(POLL_MIN_INCREMENT)
66 | 
67 |     def _on_exit(self):
68 |         try:
69 |             self.cron_job.exit = True
70 |         except AttributeError:
71 |             pass
72 |         try:
73 |             self.images_monitor.exit = True
74 |         except AttributeError:
75 |             pass
76 |         if not self.update_monitor.abortRequested():
77 |             get_property('ServiceStarted', clear_property=True)
78 |             get_property('ServiceStop', clear_property=True)
79 | 
80 | 
81 | def restart_service_monitor():
82 |     if get_property('ServiceStarted') == 'True':
83 |         wait_for_property('ServiceStop', value='True', set_property=True)  # Stop service
84 |     wait_for_property('ServiceStop', value=None)  # Wait until Service clears property
85 |     SafeThread(target=ServiceMonitor().run).start()

257 |

 88 |             return

 90 |         if not self.item.is_same_item:  # Dont bother setting if item changed before retrieved

 94 |     def artwork(self):
 95 |         if not self.item.is_same_item:  # Dont bother getting if item changed before reached
 96 |             return
 97 |         artwork = self.images_monitor.update_artwork(forced=True) or {}
 98 |         if not self.item.is_same_item:  # Dont bother setting if item changed before retrieved
 99 |             return

102 |     def start_process_artwork(self):
103 |         if not self.artwork_enabled:
104 |             return
105 | 
106 |         self.images_monitor.remote_artwork.set(self.item.identifier, self.item.artwork.copy())
107 | 
108 |         if len(self.artwork_queued) < 1:
109 |             self.artwork_queued.append(self.artwork)
110 |         else:
111 |             self.artwork_queued[0] = self.artwork
112 | 
113 |         if self.artwork_thread:
114 |             return
115 | 
116 |         self.artwork_thread = SafeThread(target=self.process_artwork)
117 |         self.artwork_thread.start()
118 | 
119 |     def process_artwork(self):
120 |         self.get_property('IsUpdatingArtwork', 'True')
121 |         while self.artwork_thread and not self.update_monitor.abortRequested():
122 |             try:
123 |                 func = self.artwork_queued.pop(0)
124 |                 func()
125 |             except IndexError:
126 |                 break
127 |         self.artwork_thread = None
128 |         self.get_property('IsUpdatingArtwork', clear_property=True)
129 |

131 |         if not self.ratings_enabled:
132 |             return
133 | 
134 |         if len(self.ratings_queued) < 1:
135 |             self.ratings_queued.append(self.ratings)
136 |         else:
137 |             self.ratings_queued[0] = self.ratings
138 | 
139 |         if self.ratings_thread:
140 |             return
141 | 
142 |         self.ratings_thread = SafeThread(target=self.process_ratings)
143 |         self.ratings_thread.start()
144 | 
145 |     def process_ratings(self):
146 |         self.get_property('IsUpdatingRatings', 'True')
147 |         while self.ratings_thread and not self.update_monitor.abortRequested():
148 |             try:
149 |                 func = self.ratings_queued.pop(0)
150 |                 func()
151 |             except IndexError:
152 |                 break
153 |         self.ratings_thread = None
154 |         self.get_property('IsUpdatingRatings', clear_property=True)
155 |

162 |         self.set_property('monitor.tmdb_id', item.tmdb_id)
163 |         self.set_property('monitor.tmdb_type', item.tmdb_type)

180 |

 36 |     def build_basedir(self, item_type=None, group=None, info=None):

 38 |         basedir = basedir or self.get_basedir_ungrouped(item_type, group)
 39 |         return basedir

 41 |     @staticmethod
 42 |     def set_grouped_item(i, info):
 43 |         iobj = i['item']
 44 |         item = iobj.item.get_item(iobj.type, mixed_dir=False)
 45 |         if i['count'] > 1:  # Only subgroup items when more than one in group
 46 |             item['params'] = {'info': info, 'group': f'{iobj.item.group}'}
 47 |             item['label'] = get_localized(iobj.item.group)
 48 |         return item
 49 | 
 50 |     def get_basedir_grouped(self, item_type=None, info=None):
 51 |         groups = {}
 52 |         for i in self.get_basedir(item_type):
 53 |             item_group = groups.setdefault(i.item.group, {'item': i, 'count': 0})
 54 |             item_group['count'] += 1
 55 |         return [
 56 |             self.set_grouped_item(i, info)
 57 |             for i in groups.values()
 58 |         ]
 59 | 
 60 |     def get_basedir_ungrouped(self, item_type=None, group=None):
 61 |         return [
 62 |             i.item.get_item(i.type, mixed_dir=bool(not item_type))
 63 |             for i in self.get_basedir(item_type)
 64 |             if not group or int(group) == i.item.group  # Convert paramstring value to int for comparison
 65 |         ]
 66 | 
 67 |     def get_basedir(self, item_type=None):
 68 |         basedir = [
 69 |             BaseDirItem(basedir_item, basedir_item_type)
 70 |             for basedir_item in self.basedir
 71 |             if basedir_item.enabled
 72 |             for basedir_item_type in basedir_item.types
 73 |             if not item_type or basedir_item_type == item_type
 74 |         ]
 75 |         return basedir

 11 | class ListSearchDir(ContainerDirectory):

 13 |     @staticmethod
 14 |     def get_searchdir(tmdb_type, clear_cache_item=True, append_type=False, **kwargs):  # list_searchdir
 15 |         base_item = {
 16 |             'label': f'{get_localized(137)} {convert_type(tmdb_type, "plural")}',
 17 |             'art': {'thumb': f'{ADDONPATH}/resources/icons/themoviedb/search.png'},
 18 |             'infoproperties': {'specialsort': 'top'},

 20 |         items = []
 21 |         items.append(base_item)
 22 | 
 23 |         history = get_search_history(tmdb_type)
 24 |         history.reverse()
 25 | 
 26 |         for i in history:
 27 |             item = {
 28 |                 'label': f'{i} ({tmdb_type})' if append_type else i,
 29 |                 'art': base_item.get('art'),
 30 |                 'params': merge_two_dicts(base_item.get('params', {}), {'query': i})}
 31 |             items.append(item)
 32 | 
 33 |         if history and clear_cache_item:
 34 |             item = {
 35 |                 'label': get_localized(32121),

 37 |                 'infoproperties': {'specialsort': 'bottom'},
 38 |                 'params': merge_two_dicts(base_item.get('params', {}), {'info': 'dir_search', 'clear_cache': 'True'})}
 39 |             items.append(item)
 40 | 
 41 |         return items

 51 | class ListMultiSearchDir(ListSearchDir):
 52 | 
 53 |     multi_search_types = ('movie', 'tv', 'person', 'both', 'collection', 'company', 'keyword')
 54 | 
 55 |     @staticmethod
 56 |     def get_zippered_list(lists):
 57 |         max_len = 0
 58 |         for i in lists:
 59 |             max_len = max(max_len, len(i))
 60 |         return [i[x] for x in range(max_len) for i in lists if x < len(i)]
 61 | 
 62 |     def get_multisearchdir(self):
 63 |         lists = [
 64 |             self.get_searchdir(i, clear_cache_item=False, append_type=True)
 65 |             for i in self.multi_search_types
 66 |         ]
 67 |         items = self.get_zippered_list(lists)
 68 | 
 69 |         if len(items) > len(self.multi_search_types):  # We have search results so need clear cache item
 70 |             items.append({
 71 |                 'label': get_localized(32121),
 72 |                 'art': {'thumb': f'{ADDONPATH}/resources/icons/themoviedb/search.png'},
 73 |                 'infoproperties': {'specialsort': 'bottom'},
 74 |                 'params': {'info': 'dir_multisearch', 'clear_cache': 'True'}})
 75 |

 79 |         self.plugin_category = get_localized(137)

 83 | 
 84 |         for tmdb_type in self.multi_search_types:

 86 |

101 |     def get_search_query(self):
102 |         from tmdbhelper.lib.addon.consts import PARAM_WIDGETS_RELOAD_FORCED
103 | 
104 |         if self.reload == PARAM_WIDGETS_RELOAD_FORCED:
105 |             return
106 | 
107 |         return set_search_history(
108 |             query=Dialog().input(get_localized(32044), type=INPUT_ALPHANUM),
109 |             tmdb_type=self.tmdb_type)
110 |

112 |         set_search_history(query=self.query, tmdb_type=self.tmdb_type)

122 | 
123 |     def configure_list_properties(self, list_properties):
124 |         list_properties = super().configure_list_properties(list_properties)
125 |         list_properties.request_url = 'search/{tmdb_type}?{paramstring}'
126 |         list_properties.localize = 137
127 |         list_properties.page_length = get_setting('pagemulti_tmdb', 'int') or 1
128 |         return list_properties
129 | 
130 |     def get_items(self, tmdb_type, query=None, page=1, length=None, update_listing=False, **kwargs):
131 |         self.list_properties.tmdb_type = tmdb_type
132 |         self.list_properties.original_query = query or ''
133 |         self.list_properties.reload = kwargs.get('reload')
134 | 
135 |         if not self.list_properties.query:
136 |             return
137 | 
138 |         # FORCE history to be saved
139 |         if self.list_properties.query and kwargs.get('history', '').lower() == 'true':
140 |             self.list_properties.set_search_query()
141 | 
142 |         request_kwgs = {
143 |             'query': self.list_properties.query,
144 |             'year': kwargs.get('year'),
145 |             'first_air_date_year': kwargs.get('first_air_date_year'),
146 |             'primary_release_year': kwargs.get('primary_release_year')
147 |         }
148 | 
149 |         # MULTI search if searching for both movies and tv
150 |         self.list_properties.url = self.list_properties.request_url.format(
151 |             tmdb_type='multi' if self.list_properties.tmdb_type == 'both' else self.list_properties.tmdb_type,
152 |             paramstring=urlencode(request_kwgs)
153 |         )
154 | 
155 |         self.list_properties.page = try_int(page) or 1
156 |         self.list_properties.length = try_int(length)
157 | 
158 |         if not self.list_properties.original_query:
159 |             params = merge_two_dicts(kwargs, {
160 |                 'info': 'search',
161 |                 'tmdb_type': self.list_properties.tmdb_type,
162 |                 'page': self.list_properties.page,
163 |                 'query': self.list_properties.query,
164 |                 'update_listing': 'True'})
165 |             self.container_update = f'{PLUGINPATH}?{urlencode(params)}'
166 |             self.parent_params = params
167 |             # Trigger container update using new path with query after adding items
168 |             # Prevents onback from re-prompting for user input by re-writing path
169 | 
170 |         self.update_listing = True if update_listing else False
171 |         self.list_properties.plugin_name = f'{{localized}} - {self.list_properties.query.capitalize()} ({{plural}})'
172 |         return self.get_items_finalised()

 75 |         if not self.kodi_db:

 78 |             unique_ids = item['unique_ids']
 79 |             infolabels = item['infolabels']
 80 |         except (KeyError, TypeError):
 81 |             return
 82 |         return self.kodi_db.get_info(
 83 |             info='dbid',
 84 |             imdb_id=unique_ids.get('imdb'),
 85 |             tmdb_id=unique_ids.get('tmdb'),
 86 |             tvdb_id=unique_ids.get('tvdb'),
 87 |             originaltitle=infolabels.get('originaltitle'),
 88 |             title=infolabels.get('title'),
 89 |             year=infolabels.get('year')
 90 |         )

 94 |         return (
 95 |             i for xpage in self.next_page_generator
 96 |             for i in self.class_pages(self, xpage).items
 97 |             if i and self.get_dbid(i)
 98 |         )

102 |         final_items = []
103 |         for x, i in enumerate(self.item_generator):
104 |             if x >= self.item_limit:

106 |             final_items.append(i)
107 |         return final_items

 13 |     @property
 14 |     def cached_data_values(self):
 15 |         """ WHERE condition ? ? ? ? = value, value, value, value """

 17 | 
 18 |     @cached_property

 26 |     @cached_property

 31 |     def imdb_top250_list(self):

 33 | 
 34 |     def get_mediatype(self):
 35 |         if self.tmdb_type == 'movie':
 36 |             return 'movie'
 37 |         if self.tmdb_type == 'tv':
 38 |             return 'tvshow'
 39 | 
 40 |     def get_trakt_type(self):
 41 |         if self.tmdb_type == 'movie':
 42 |             return 'movie'
 43 |         if self.tmdb_type == 'tv':
 44 |             return 'show'
 45 | 
 46 |     def get_imdb_id(self):
 47 |         return FindQueriesDatabase().get_trakt_id(self.tmdb_id, 'tmdb', self.trakt_type, 'imdb')
 48 | 
 49 |     def get_imdb_top250_list(self):
 50 |         return FindQueriesDatabase().get_imdb_top250_list_cached(self.tmdb_type)
 51 | 
 52 |     @cached_property
 53 |     def mdblist_ratings(self):
 54 |         if not self.common_apis.mdblist_api:
 55 |             return {}
 56 |         return self.common_apis.mdblist_api.get_ratings(self.trakt_type, self.tmdb_id) or {}
 57 | 
 58 |     @cached_property
 59 |     def imdb_top250(self):
 60 |         try:
 61 |             return {'top250': self.imdb_top250_list.index(try_int(self.tmdb_id)) + 1}  # Must be an int to match
 62 |         except (KeyError, TypeError, IndexError, ValueError):
 63 |             return {}
 64 | 
 65 |     @cached_property
 66 |     def omdb_ratings(self):
 67 |         if not self.common_apis.omdb_api or not self.imdb_id:
 68 |             return {}
 69 |         try:
 70 |             return self.common_apis.omdb_api.get_ratings_awards(imdb_id=self.imdb_id) or {}
 71 |         except (KeyError, TypeError, IndexError, ValueError):
 72 |             return {}
 73 | 
 74 |     @cached_property
 75 |     def trakt_ratings(self):
 76 |         if not self.common_apis.trakt_api or not self.common_apis.trakt_api.authenticator.is_authorized or not self.imdb_id:
 77 |             return {}
 78 |         data = self.common_apis.trakt_api.get_response_json(f'{self.trakt_type}s/{self.imdb_id}/ratings')
 79 |         if not data:
 80 |             return {}
 81 |         try:
 82 |             return {
 83 |                 'trakt_rating': int(float(data['rating']) * 10),  # Convert /10 float to /100 int
 84 |                 'trakt_votes': int(data['votes']),
 85 |             }
 86 |         except (KeyError, TypeError, IndexError, ValueError):
 87 |             return {}
 88 | 
 89 |     @cached_property
 90 |     def tmdb_ratings(self):
 91 |         data = self.common_apis.tmdb_api.get_response_json(self.tmdb_type, self.tmdb_id)
 92 |         if not data:
 93 |             return {}
 94 |         try:
 95 |             return {
 96 |                 'tmdb_rating': int(data['vote_average'] * 10),
 97 |                 'tmdb_votes': data['vote_count']
 98 |             }
 99 |         except (KeyError, TypeError, IndexError, ValueError):
100 |             return {}
101 | 
102 |     @cached_property
103 |     def online_data_mapped(self):
104 |         """ function called when local cache does not have any data """
105 |         data = {}
106 | 
107 |         def get_data_attr(attr):
108 |             data.update(getattr(self, attr))
109 | 
110 |         attribs = (
111 |             'omdb_ratings',
112 |             'mdblist_ratings',
113 |             'trakt_ratings',
114 |             'tmdb_ratings',
115 |             'imdb_top250',
116 |         )
117 | 
118 |         self.mediatype = self.get_mediatype()
119 |         self.trakt_type = self.get_trakt_type()
120 |         self.imdb_id = self.get_imdb_id()
121 | 
122 |         with ParallelThread(attribs, get_data_attr):
123 |             pass
124 | 
125 |         return data
126 | 
127 |     def configure_mapped_data(self, data):
128 |         def get_value(k):
129 |             if k == 'id':
130 |                 return self.item_id
131 |             if k == 'expiry':
132 |                 return self.expiry
133 |             try:
134 |                 return data[k]
135 |             except (TypeError, KeyError, IndexError, ValueError):
136 |                 return
137 |         return [get_value(k) for k in self.keys]
138 | 
139 |     def get_cached_data(self):
140 |         data = self.get_unmapped_data()
141 |         if not data:
142 |             return
143 | 
144 |         ratings_style = {
145 |             'tmdb_rating': lambda v: f'{(v / 10):.1f}',
146 |             'trakt_rating': lambda v: f'{(v / 10):.1f}',
147 |             'imdb_rating': lambda v: f'{(v / 10):.1f}',
148 |             'letterboxd_rating': lambda v: f'{(v / 20):.1f}',  # 5 Star rating
149 |             'rogerebert_rating': lambda v: f'{(v / 25):.1f}',  # 4 Star rating
150 |         }
151 | 
152 |         mapped_data = {}
153 | 
154 |         for k in data[0].keys():
155 |             if k in ('id', 'expiry'):
156 |                 continue
157 | 
158 |             v = data[0][k]
159 | 
160 |             if not v:
161 |                 continue
162 | 
163 |             mapped_data[k] = v
164 | 
165 |             if not isinstance(v, int):
166 |                 continue
167 | 
168 |             if not k.endswith('_rating'):
169 |                 mapped_data[f'comma_{k}'] = f'{v:,d}'
170 |                 continue
171 | 
172 |             mapped_data[f'percent_{k}'] = v
173 |             mapped_data[f'decimal_{k}'] = f'{(v / 10):.1f}'
174 |             mapped_data[f'starred_{k}'] = f'{(v / 20):.1f}'
175 | 
176 |             try:
177 |                 mapped_data[k] = ratings_style[k](v)
178 |             except KeyError:
179 |                 mapped_data[k] = v
180 | 
181 |         return mapped_data
182 | 
183 |     def try_cached_data(self, return_data=False):
184 |         if not self.parent_item_data:
185 |             return
186 |         if not self.online_data_mapped:
187 |             return
188 | 
189 |         func = self.set_cached_values
190 |         args = (self.table, self.item_id, self.keys)
191 |         kwgs = {'values': self.configure_mapped_data(self.online_data_mapped)}
192 | 
193 |         with self.connection.open():
194 |             self.connection.open_connection.execute('BEGIN')
195 |             func(*args, **kwgs)
196 |             self.connection.open_connection.execute('COMMIT')
197 | 
198 |         if not return_data:
199 |             return
200 |         return self.get_cached_data()
201 | </file>
202 | 
```

 84 |     def get_infoproperties_dbclist(self, infoproperties):

 86 |             instance = d['instance']
 87 |             mappings = d['mappings']
 88 |             propname = d['propname']
 89 |             joinings = d['joinings']
 90 |             instance = self.return_basemeta_db(*instance)
 91 |             for x, i in enumerate(instance.cached_data, 1):
 92 |                 for dkey, ikey in mappings.items():
 93 |                     data = self.get_configured_item_value(i, ikey, instance)
 94 |                     if data is None:
 95 |                         continue
 96 |                     for name in propname:
 97 |                         infoproperties[f'{name}.{x}.{dkey}'] = data
 98 |             if joinings is None:
 99 |                 continue
100 |             join_data = [i[joinings[1]] for i in instance.cached_data if i[joinings[1]]]
101 |             infoproperties[joinings[0]] = ' / '.join(join_data)
102 |             infoproperties[f'{joinings[0]}_CR'] = '[CR]'.join(join_data)

122 |             attr, subtype = instance

124 | 
125 |             try:
126 |                 datalist = instance.cached_data if attr == 'art_extrafanart' else [instance.cached_data[0]]
127 |             except(KeyError, TypeError, IndexError, AttributeError):
128 |                 continue
129 |             x = 0
130 |             for i in datalist:
131 | 
132 |                 url = i['icon']
133 |                 if not url:
134 |                     continue
135 | 
136 |                 if attr == 'art_extrafanart':
137 |                     x += 1
138 |                     this_dkey = f'{dkey}{x}'

140 |                     this_dkey = dkey
141 | 
142 |                 url = instance.image_path_func(url)
143 | 
144 |                 art[this_dkey] = art.get(this_dkey) or url
145 | 
146 |                 if not subtype:
147 |                     continue
148 | 
149 |                 subtype_dkey = f'{subtype}.{this_dkey}'
150 |                 art[subtype_dkey] = art.get(subtype_dkey) or url
151 |

144 |         def get_art_tuple(route):

159 |                 return

161 |             return ((art_route, self.parent_type), definition['outputs'])

348 |     )
349 | 
350 |     def get_infoproperties_custom(self, infoproperties, subtype=None):
351 |         for i in self.return_basemeta_db('custom', subtype).cached_data:
352 |             infoproperties[self.get_subtype_key(i['key'], subtype)] = i['value']
353 |         return infoproperties
354 | 
355 |     def get_infoproperties_translation(self, infoproperties, subtype=None):
356 |         if self.extendedinfo:
357 | 
358 |             generator = (
359 |                 (
360 |                     f"{i['iso_language']}_{subtype or ''}{k}",
361 |                     f"{i['iso_language']}-{i['iso_country']}_{subtype or ''}{k}",
362 |                     i[k]
363 |                 )
364 |                 for i in self.return_basemeta_db('translation', subtype).cached_data
365 |                 for k in ('title', 'plot', 'tagline')
366 |                 if i[k]
367 |             )
368 | 
369 |             for key_language, key_combined, value in generator:
370 |                 infoproperties[key_combined] = value
371 |                 infoproperties[key_language] = infoproperties.get(key_language) or value
372 | 
373 |         return infoproperties
374 | 
375 |     def get_infoproperties_progress(self, infoproperties):
376 |         duration = self.get_data_value('duration')
377 |         if not duration:
378 |             return infoproperties
379 | 
380 |         progress = self.get_instance_cached_data_value(self.return_basemeta_db('playprogress'), 'playback_progress')
381 |         if not progress or progress < 4 or progress > 96:
382 |             progress = 0
383 | 
384 |         infoproperties['ResumeTime'] = int(duration * progress // 100)
385 |         infoproperties['TotalTime'] = int(duration)
386 |         return infoproperties
387 | 
388 |     def get_infoproperties_lastplayed(self, infoproperties):
389 |         func_get = self.get_instance_cached_data_value
390 |         func_dbc = self.return_basemeta_db
391 |         lastplayed_timestamp = func_get(func_dbc('lastplayed'), 'lastplayed')
392 |         if not lastplayed_timestamp:
393 |             return infoproperties
394 |         infoproperties.update(ItemMapperMethods.get_custom_date(
395 |             lastplayed_timestamp, name='lastplayed'
396 |         ))
397 |         return infoproperties
398 | 
399 |     def get_infoproperties_ranks(self, infoproperties):
400 |         func_get = self.get_instance_cached_data_value
401 |         func_dbc = self.return_basemeta_db
402 | 
403 |         for database, column, name, func in (
404 |             ('favorites_rank', 'favorites_rank', 'favorites_rank', None),
405 |             ('watchlist_rank', 'watchlist_rank', 'watchlist_rank', None),
406 |             ('collected_date', 'collection_last_collected_at', 'collected_date', lambda i: i[:10]),
407 |         ):
408 |             rank = func_get(func_dbc(database), column)
409 |             if not rank:
410 |                 continue
411 |             infoproperties[name] = func(rank) if func else rank
412 | 
413 |         return infoproperties
414 | 
415 |     def get_infoproperties_next_ep(self, infoproperties):
416 | 
417 |         try:
418 |             for column in ('next_aired', 'last_aired'):
419 | 
420 |                 episode_id = self.get_data_value(f'{column}_id')
421 | 
422 |                 if not episode_id:
423 |                     continue
424 | 
425 |                 for affix in (
426 |                     'id', 'episode', 'year', 'premiered', 'duration',
427 |                     'rating', 'votes', 'popularity', 'title', 'plot'
428 |                 ):
429 |                     infoproperties[f'{column}.{affix}'] = self.get_data_value(f'{column}_{affix}')
430 | 
431 |                 id_split = episode_id.split('.')
432 | 
433 |                 infoproperties.update({
434 |                     f'{column}.tmdb_type': id_split[0],
435 |                     f'{column}.tmdb_id': id_split[1],
436 |                     f'{column}.season': id_split[2],
437 |                     f'{column}.episode': id_split[3],
438 |                 })
439 | 
440 |                 infoproperties.update(
441 |                     ItemMapperMethods.get_custom_date(
442 |                         self.get_data_value(f'{column}_premiered'), name=column
443 |                     )
444 |                 )
445 | 
446 |                 infoproperties.update(
447 |                     ItemMapperMethods.get_custom_time(
448 |                         self.get_data_value(f'{column}_duration'), name='duration'))
449 | 
450 |         except (TypeError, KeyError, IndexError):
451 |             pass
452 | 
453 |         return infoproperties
454 | 
455 |     def get_unique_ids(self, unique_ids, subtype=None):
456 |         for i in (self.return_basemeta_db('unique_id', subtype).cached_data or ()):
457 |             unique_ids[self.get_subtype_key(i['key'], subtype)] = i['value']
458 |         unique_ids[self.get_subtype_key('tmdb', subtype)] = self.parent_db_cache.tmdb_id
459 |         return unique_ids
460 |

462 |     def cast(self):
463 |         return [
464 |             {

466 |                 'role': i['role'],
467 |                 'order': i['ordering'] or 999999,
468 |                 'thumbnail': self.parent_db_cache.common_apis.tmdb_imagepath.get_imagepath_poster(i['thumb'])
469 |             }
470 |             for i in self.return_basemeta_db('castmember').cached_data
471 |         ]

108 | 				except: return self.notification('Error with Trakt List')
109 | 				hide_busy_dialog()
110 | 			else: return

112 | 		if action in self.selection_actions:
113 | 			try: chosen_var = self.get_listitem(self.control_id).getProperty(self.item_action_dict[self.control_id])

124 | 				return window_manager(self)

132 | 			elif self.control_id in open_folder_list_ids:

347 | 	def make_videos(self):

350 | 		def _sort_trailers(trailers):
351 | 			official_trailers = [i for i in trailers if i['official'] and i['type'] == 'Trailer' and 'official trailer' in i['name'].lower()]
352 | 			other_official_trailers = [i for i in trailers if i['official'] and i['type'] == 'Trailer' and not i in official_trailers]
353 | 			other_trailers = [i for i in trailers if i['type'] == 'Trailer' and not i in official_trailers  and not i in other_official_trailers]
354 | 			teaser_trailers = [i for i in trailers if i['type'] == 'Teaser']
355 | 			full_trailers = official_trailers + other_official_trailers + other_trailers + teaser_trailers
356 | 			features = [i for i in trailers if not i in full_trailers]
357 | 			return full_trailers + features

449 | 			kodi_clock = self.get_infolabel('System.Time')

451 | 			else: _format = '%H:%M'
452 | 			if percent_watched in ('0', '100'): remaining_time = self.duration_data
453 | 			else: remaining_time = ((100 - int(percent_watched))/100) * self.duration_data
454 | 			current_time = datetime.now()
455 | 			finish_time = current_time + timedelta(minutes=remaining_time)
456 | 			finished = finish_time.strftime(_format)
457 | 			finish_str = '%s: %s' % (label, finished)
458 | 		return finish_str

197 |     def __init__(self, parent, items):

208 |         with TimerList(self.timer_lists, ' - cached', log_threshold=0.001, logging=self.log_timers):
209 |             with self.connection.open():
210 |                 return self.get_cached_data()

223 |         return [

225 |             if cached_item is None and self.items[x].is_cacheable
226 |         ]

240 |         with TimerList(self.timer_lists, ' - online', log_threshold=0.001, logging=self.log_timers):
241 |             return self.get_func_queue()
242 | 
243 |     def get_func_queue(self):
244 | 
245 |         def _queued_data(listitem_config):
246 |             return listitem_config.try_queued_data()
247 | 
248 |         with ParallelThread(self.uncached_items, _queued_data) as pt:
249 |             item_queue = pt.queue
250 | 
251 |         return list(itertools.chain.from_iterable((i for i in item_queue if i)))
252 | 
253 |     def set_func_queue(self):
254 |         self.connection.open_connection.execute('BEGIN')
255 |         with TimerList(self.timer_lists, ' - writer', log_threshold=0.001, logging=self.log_timers):
256 |             for func, args, kwgs in self.func_queue:
257 |                 func(*args, **kwgs)
258 |         with TimerList(self.timer_lists, ' - commit', log_threshold=0.001, logging=self.log_timers):
259 |             self.connection.open_connection.execute('COMMIT')
260 |         with TimerList(self.timer_lists, ' - return', log_threshold=0.001, logging=self.log_timers):
261 |             self.cached_data = self.get_cached_data()

267 |         if not self.uncached_items:
268 |             return self.configured_list
269 |         if not self.func_queue:
270 |             return self.configured_list
271 |         with self.connection.open():
272 |             self.set_func_queue()
273 |         return self.configured_list

 511 |     def get_fanart_tv(self, items, **kwargs):
 512 |         if not items:
 513 |             return
 514 | 
 515 |         # FTV artwork key name, type to map it to, art_has_seasons
 516 |         # Set art_has_seasons to FTV_TVSHOWS_SEASONS for artwork where fanarttv intends "season=all" to be "tvshow" artwork
 517 |         # Set art_has_seasons to FTV_SEASONS_SEASONS for artwork where fanarttv intends "season=all" to be "season" artwork
 518 |         art_types = {
 519 |             'movieposter': ('poster', FTV_WITHOUT_SEASONS),
 520 |             'moviebackground': ('fanart', FTV_WITHOUT_SEASONS),
 521 |             'moviethumb': ('landscape', FTV_WITHOUT_SEASONS),
 522 |             'moviebanner': ('banner', FTV_WITHOUT_SEASONS),
 523 |             'hdmovieclearart': ('clearart', FTV_WITHOUT_SEASONS),
 524 |             'movieclearart': ('clearart', FTV_WITHOUT_SEASONS),
 525 |             'hdmovielogo': ('clearlogo', FTV_WITHOUT_SEASONS),
 526 |             'movielogo': ('clearlogo', FTV_WITHOUT_SEASONS),
 527 |             'moviedisc': ('discart', FTV_WITHOUT_SEASONS),
 528 |             'tvposter': ('poster', FTV_WITHOUT_SEASONS),
 529 |             'tvthumb': ('landscape', FTV_WITHOUT_SEASONS),
 530 |             'tvbanner': ('banner', FTV_WITHOUT_SEASONS),
 531 |             'hdclearart': ('clearart', FTV_WITHOUT_SEASONS),
 532 |             'clearart': ('clearart', FTV_WITHOUT_SEASONS),
 533 |             'hdtvlogo': ('clearlogo', FTV_WITHOUT_SEASONS),
 534 |             'clearlogo': ('clearlogo', FTV_WITHOUT_SEASONS),
 535 |             'characterart': ('characterart', FTV_WITHOUT_SEASONS),
 536 |             'showbackground': ('fanart', FTV_TVSHOWS_SEASONS),
 537 |             'seasonposter': ('poster', FTV_SEASONS_SEASONS),
 538 |             'seasonbanner': ('banner', FTV_SEASONS_SEASONS),
 539 |             'seasonthumb': ('landscape', FTV_SEASONS_SEASONS),
 540 |         }
 541 | 
 542 |         data = []
 543 |         for art_type, art_list in items.items():
 544 | 
 545 |             if not isinstance(art_list, list):
 546 |                 continue
 547 | 
 548 |             quality = 1 if art_type.startswith('hd') else 0
 549 | 
 550 |             art_type = art_types.get(art_type)
 551 |             if not art_type:
 552 |                 continue
 553 | 
 554 |             art_type, art_has_seasons = art_type
 555 | 
 556 |             for art_item in art_list:
 557 |                 icon = get_blanks_none(art_item['url'])
 558 | 
 559 |                 if not icon:
 560 |                     continue
 561 | 
 562 |                 item = {
 563 |                     'icon': icon,
 564 |                     'iso_language': get_blanks_none(art_item.get('lang')),
 565 |                     'likes': get_blanks_none(art_item.get('likes')),
 566 |                     'type': get_blanks_none(art_type),
 567 |                     'quality': get_blanks_none(quality),
 568 |                     'extension': get_blanks_none(icon.split('.')[-1] if icon else None),
 569 |                 }
 570 | 
 571 |                 if art_has_seasons:
 572 |                     # Some artwork on FanartTV uses season=all to indicate tvshow artwork
 573 |                     # While other artwork types use season=all to indicate season artwork for an "all" season...
 574 |                     # Do some gymnastics here to workaround this mess of conflated types
 575 |                     snum = (art_item.get('season') or 'all')
 576 | 
 577 |                     # Set "All Seasons" artwork to -1 season so we dont pull it in for a tvshow if it is really intended to be an "all" season type
 578 |                     if snum == 'all' and art_has_seasons == FTV_SEASONS_SEASONS:
 579 |                         snum = -1
 580 | 
 581 |                     # Set season artwork with a number ot season type
 582 |                     if snum != 'all':
 583 |                         parent_id = f'tv.{self.tmdb_id}.{snum}'
 584 | 
 585 |                         item['parent_id'] = parent_id
 586 | 
 587 |                         data.append(ExtendedMap('baseitem', parent_id, False, {
 588 |                             'id': parent_id,
 589 |                             'mediatype': 'season',
 590 |                             'expiry': 0,
 591 |                             'language': self.language,
 592 |                         }))
 593 | 
 594 |                 data.append(ExtendedMap('fanart_tv', icon, True, item))
 595 | 
 596 |         return data

 620 |     @staticmethod
 621 |     def get_aspect_ratio(aspect_ratio):
 622 |         from tmdbhelper.lib.addon.consts import IMAGEPATH_ASPECTRATIO
 623 |         if aspect_ratio < 1:
 624 |             return IMAGEPATH_ASPECTRATIO.index('poster')
 625 |         if aspect_ratio == 1:
 626 |             return IMAGEPATH_ASPECTRATIO.index('square')
 627 |         if 1.7 <= aspect_ratio <= 1.8:
 628 |             return IMAGEPATH_ASPECTRATIO.index('landscape')
 629 |         if aspect_ratio < 1.7:
 630 |             return IMAGEPATH_ASPECTRATIO.index('thumb')
 631 |         if aspect_ratio > 1.8:
 632 |             return IMAGEPATH_ASPECTRATIO.index('wide')
 633 |         return IMAGEPATH_ASPECTRATIO.index('other')
 634 |
