 647 |                         'aspect_ratio': ItemMapperMethods.get_aspect_ratio(artwork['aspect_ratio']),
 648 |                         'quality': int((artwork['width'] * artwork['height']) // 200000),  # Quality integer to nearest fifth of a megapixel
 649 |                         'iso_language': get_blanks_none(artwork['iso_639_1']),
 650 |                         'iso_country': get_blanks_none(artwork['iso_3166_1']),
 651 |                         'icon': get_blanks_none(path),
 652 |                         'type': get_blanks_none(artwork_type),
 653 |                         'extension': get_blanks_none(path.split('.')[-1] if path else None),
 654 |                         'rating': int(artwork['vote_average'] * 100),
 655 |                         'votes': get_blanks_none(artwork['vote_count'])
 656 |                     })
 657 |                 )
 658 | 
 659 |         return data

 673 |     @staticmethod
 674 |     def get_custom_time(duration, name='duration'):
 675 |         if not duration:
 676 |             return {}
 677 |         minutes = duration // 60 % 60
 678 |         hours = duration // 60 // 60
 679 |         totalmin = duration // 60
 680 |         infoproperties = {
 681 |             f'{name}.H': hours,
 682 |             f'{name}.M': minutes,
 683 |             f'{name}.mins': totalmin,
 684 |             f'{name}.HHMM': f'{hours:02d}:{minutes:02d}',
 685 |         }
 686 |         return infoproperties

 688 |     @staticmethod
 689 |     def get_custom_date(air_date, name):
 690 |         from tmdbhelper.lib.addon.plugin import get_infolabel
 691 |         from tmdbhelper.lib.addon.tmdate import format_date_obj, convert_timestamp, get_days_to_air
 692 |         air_date_obj = convert_timestamp(air_date, time_fmt="%Y-%m-%d", time_lim=10, utc_convert=False)
 693 | 
 694 |         if not air_date_obj:
 695 |             return {}
 696 | 
 697 |         infoproperties = {
 698 |             f'{name}': format_date_obj(air_date_obj, region_fmt='dateshort'),
 699 |             f'{name}.long': format_date_obj(air_date_obj, region_fmt='datelong'),
 700 |             f'{name}.short': format_date_obj(air_date_obj, "%d %b"),
 701 |             f'{name}.day': format_date_obj(air_date_obj, "%A"),
 702 |             f'{name}.day_short': format_date_obj(air_date_obj, "%a"),
 703 |             f'{name}.year': format_date_obj(air_date_obj, "%Y"),
 704 |             f'{name}.custom': format_date_obj(air_date_obj, get_infolabel('Skin.String(TMDbHelper.Date.Format)') or '%d %b %Y'),
 705 |             f'{name}.original': air_date,
 706 |         }
 707 | 
 708 |         days_to_air, is_aired = get_days_to_air(air_date_obj)
 709 |         days_to_air_name = f'{name}.days_from_aired' if is_aired else f'{name}.days_until_aired'
 710 | 
 711 |         infoproperties[days_to_air_name] = str(days_to_air)
 712 |         return infoproperties

 785 | class ItemMapper(_ItemMapper, ItemMapperMethods):
 786 |     def __init__(self, language, tmdb_id):
 787 |         self.blacklist = ()
 788 |         """ Mapping dictionary
 789 |         keys:       list of tuples containing parent and child key to add value. [('parent', 'child')]
 790 |                     parent keys: art, unique_ids, infolabels, infoproperties, params
 791 |                     use UPDATE_BASEKEY for child key to update parent with a dict
 792 |         func:       function to call to manipulate values (omit to skip and pass value directly)
 793 |         (kw)args:   list/dict of args/kwargs to pass to func.
 794 |                     func is also always passed v as first argument
 795 |         type:       int, float, str - convert v to type using try_type(v, type)
 796 |         extend:     set True to add to existing list - leave blank to overwrite exiting list
 797 |         subkeys:    list of sub keys to get for v - i.e. v.get(subkeys[0], {}).get(subkeys[1]) etc.
 798 |                     note that getting subkeys sticks for entire loop so do other ops on base first if needed
 799 | 
 800 |         use standard_map for direct one-to-one mapping of v onto single property tuple
 801 |         """
 802 |         self.advanced_map = {
 803 |             'name': [{
 804 |                 'keys': [('item', 'title')]}, {
 805 |                 'keys': [('item', 'name')],
 806 |             }],
 807 |             'release_date': [{
 808 |                 'keys': [('item', 'premiered')]}, {
 809 |                 'keys': [('item', 'year')],
 810 |                 'func': lambda v: int(v[0:4])
 811 |             }],
 812 |             'first_air_date': [{
 813 |                 'keys': [('item', 'premiered')]}, {
 814 |                 'keys': [('item', 'year')],
 815 |                 'func': lambda v: int(v[0:4])
 816 |             }],
 817 |             'air_date': [{
 818 |                 'keys': [('item', 'premiered')]}, {
 819 |                 'keys': [('item', 'year')],
 820 |                 'func': lambda v: int(v[0:4])
 821 |             }],

 963 |         map_dict = {}
 964 | 
 965 |         for k, v in data.items():
 966 | 
 967 |             # Skip blank values
 968 |             if v in (None, ''):
 969 |                 continue
 970 | 
 971 |             # Only some values need extended mappings
 972 |             if k not in self.extended_map:
 973 |                 continue
 974 | 
 975 |             # Make sure the function outputs data
 976 |             output = self.extended_map[k](v)
 977 |             if not output:
 978 |                 continue
 979 | 
 980 |             for i in output:
 981 | 
 982 |                 # Make sure unique_id has a value we can use as an ID
 983 |                 if not i.unique_id:
 984 |                     continue
 985 | 
 986 |                 dictionary = map_dict.setdefault(i.base, {})
 987 | 
 988 |                 # Overwrite set so just overwrite and move on
 989 |                 if i.overwrite:
 990 |                     dictionary[i.unique_id] = i.data
 991 |                     continue
 992 | 
 993 |                 # ID not mapped yet so write it and move on
 994 |                 if i.unique_id not in dictionary:
 995 |                     dictionary[i.unique_id] = i.data
 996 |                     continue
 997 | 
 998 |                 # Only write new values
 999 |                 for ik, iv in i.data.items():
1000 |                     if not dictionary[i.unique_id].get(ik):  # Dont write over existing values
1001 |                         continue
1002 |                     dictionary[i.unique_id][ik] = iv  # No value set so update it
1003 | 
1004 |         for key, dictionary in map_dict.items():
1005 |             item[key] = tuple([d for d in dictionary.values()])
1006 | 
1007 |         return item

 66 | 		if params: self.params = params
 67 | 		params_get = self.params.get
 68 | 		self.play_type, self.background, self.prescrape = params_get('play_type', ''), params_get('background', 'false') == 'true', params_get('prescrape', self.prescrape) == 'true'
 69 | 		self.random, self.random_continual = params_get('random', 'false') == 'true', params_get('random_continual', 'false') == 'true'
 70 | 		if self.play_type:
 71 | 			if self.play_type == 'autoplay_nextep': self.autoplay_nextep, self.autoscrape_nextep = True, False
 72 | 			elif self.play_type == 'random_continual': self.autoplay_nextep, self.autoscrape_nextep = False, False
 73 | 			else: self.autoplay_nextep, self.autoscrape_nextep = False, True
 74 | 		else: self.autoplay_nextep, self.autoscrape_nextep = autoplay_next_episode(), autoscrape_next_episode()
 75 | 		self.autoscrape = self.autoscrape_nextep and self.background
 76 | 		self.auto_rescrape_with_all, self.auto_episode_group = auto_rescrape_with_all(), auto_episode_group()
 77 | 		self.nextep_settings, self.disable_autoplay_next_episode = params_get('nextep_settings', {}), params_get('disable_autoplay_next_episode', 'false') == 'true'
 78 | 		self.ignore_scrape_filters = params_get('ignore_scrape_filters', 'false') == 'true'
 79 | 		self.disabled_ext_ignored = params_get('disabled_ext_ignored', self.disabled_ext_ignored) == 'true'
 80 | 		self.default_ext_only = params_get('default_ext_only', self.default_ext_only) == 'true'
 81 | 		self.folders_ignore_filters = get_setting('fenlight.results.folders_ignore_filters', 'false') == 'true'
 82 | 		self.filter_size_method = int(get_setting('fenlight.results.filter_size_method', '0'))
 83 | 		self.media_type, self.tmdb_id = params_get('media_type'), params_get('tmdb_id')		
 84 | 		self.custom_title, self.custom_year = params_get('custom_title', None), params_get('custom_year', None)
 85 | 		self.episode_group_label = params_get('episode_group_label', '')
 86 | 		if self.media_type == 'episode':
 87 | 			self.season, self.episode = int(params_get('season')), int(params_get('episode'))
 88 | 			self.custom_season, self.custom_episode = params_get('custom_season', None), params_get('custom_episode', None)
 89 | 			self.check_episode_group()
 90 | 		else: self.season, self.episode, self.custom_season, self.custom_episode = '', '', '', ''
 91 | 		if 'autoplay' in self.params: self.autoplay = params_get('autoplay', 'false') == 'true'
 92 | 		else: self.autoplay = auto_play(self.media_type)
 93 | 		self.get_meta()
 94 | 		if self.media_type == 'episode' and not any([self.custom_season, self.custom_episode]):
 95 | 			_ep_map = self.meta.get('tvdb_to_tmdb_ep') or {}
 96 | 			_tmdb_val = _ep_map.get((self.season, self.episode))
 97 | 			if _tmdb_val and _tmdb_val[0] == self.season and _tmdb_val[1] != self.episode:
 98 | 				self.custom_episode = _tmdb_val[1]
 99 | 		self.determine_scrapers_status()
100 | 		self.sleep_time, self.provider_sort_ranks, self.scraper_settings = 100, provider_sort_ranks(), scraping_settings()
101 | 		self.include_prerelease_results, self.ignore_results_filter, self.limit_resolve = include_prerelease_results(), ignore_results_filter(), limit_resolve()
102 | 		self.sort_function, self.quality_filter = results_sort_order(), self._quality_filter()
103 | 		self.include_unknown_size = get_setting('fenlight.results.size_unknown', 'false') == 'true'
104 | 		self.make_search_info()
105 | 		if self.autoscrape: self.autoscrape_nextep_handler()
106 | 		else: return self.get_sources()

108 | 	def check_episode_group(self):
109 | 		try:
110 | 			if any([self.custom_season, self.custom_episode]) or 'skip_episode_group_check' in self.params: return
111 | 			group_info = episode_groups_cache.get(self.tmdb_id)
112 | 			if not group_info: return
113 | 			group_details = metadata.group_episode_data(metadata.group_details(group_info['id']), None, self.season, self.episode)
114 | 			if group_details:
115 | 				self.custom_season, self.custom_episode, self.episode_group_used = group_details['season'], group_details['episode'], True
116 | 				self.episode_group_label = '[B]CUSTOM GROUP: S%02dE%02d[/B]' % (self.custom_season, self.custom_episode)
117 | 		except: self.custom_season, self.custom_episode = None, None

119 | 	def determine_scrapers_status(self):
120 | 		self.active_internal_scrapers = active_internal_scrapers()
121 | 		if not 'external' in self.active_internal_scrapers and (self.disabled_ext_ignored or self.default_ext_only): self.active_internal_scrapers.append('external')
122 | 		self.active_external = 'external' in self.active_internal_scrapers
123 | 		if self.active_external:
124 | 			self.debrid_enabled = debrid_enabled()
125 | 			if not self.debrid_enabled: return self.disable_external('No Debrid Services Enabled')
126 | 			self.ext_folder, self.ext_name = external_scraper_info()
127 | 			if not self.ext_folder or not self.ext_name: return self.disable_external('Error Importing External Module')

129 | 	def get_sources(self):
130 | 		if not self.progress_dialog and not self.background: self._make_progress_dialog()
131 | 		results = []
132 | 		if self.prescrape and any(x in self.active_internal_scrapers for x in default_internal_scrapers):
133 | 			if self.prepare_internal_scrapers():
134 | 				results = self.collect_prescrape_results()
135 | 				if results: results = self.process_results(results)
136 | 		if not results:
137 | 			self.prescrape = False
138 | 			self.prepare_internal_scrapers()
139 | 			if self.active_external: self.activate_external_providers()
140 | 			elif not self.active_internal_scrapers: self._kill_progress_dialog()
141 | 			self.orig_results = self.collect_results()
142 | 			if not self.orig_results and not self.active_external: self._kill_progress_dialog()
143 | 			results = self.process_results(self.orig_results)
144 | 		if not results: return self._process_post_results()
145 | 		if self.autoscrape: return results
146 | 		else: return self.play_source(results)

148 | 	def collect_results(self):
149 | 		self.sources.extend(self.prescrape_sources)
150 | 		threads_append = self.threads.append
151 | 		if self.active_folders: self.append_folder_scrapers(self.providers)
152 | 		self.providers.extend(self.internal_sources())
153 | 		if self.providers:
154 | 			for i in self.providers: threads_append(Thread(target=self.activate_providers, args=(i[0], i[1], False), name=i[2]))
155 | 			[i.start() for i in self.threads]
156 | 		if self.active_external or self.background:
157 | 			if self.active_external:
158 | 				if any((i[0] == 'comet' for i in self.external_providers)):
159 | 					debrid_service = self.debrid_enabled[0]
160 | 					debrid_token = get_setting('fenlight.%s' % debrid_token_dict[debrid_service])
161 | 				else: debrid_service, debrid_token = '', ''
162 | 				self.external_args = (self.meta, self.external_providers, self.debrid_enabled, debrid_service, debrid_token, self.internal_scraper_names,
163 | 										self.prescrape_sources, self.progress_dialog, self.disabled_ext_ignored)
164 | 				self.activate_providers('external', external, False)
165 | 			if self.background: [i.join() for i in self.threads]
166 | 		elif self.active_internal_scrapers: self.scrapers_dialog()
167 | 		return self.sources

169 | 	def collect_prescrape_results(self):
170 | 		threads_append = self.prescrape_threads.append
171 | 		if self.active_folders:
172 | 			if self.autoplay or check_prescrape_sources('folders', self.media_type):
173 | 				self.append_folder_scrapers(self.prescrape_scrapers)
174 | 				self.remove_scrapers.append('folders')
175 | 		self.prescrape_scrapers.extend(self.internal_sources(True))
176 | 		if not self.prescrape_scrapers: return []
177 | 		for i in self.prescrape_scrapers: threads_append(Thread(target=self.activate_providers, args=(i[0], i[1], True), name=i[2]))
178 | 		[i.start() for i in self.prescrape_threads]
179 | 		self.remove_scrapers.extend(i[2] for i in self.prescrape_scrapers)
180 | 		if self.background: [i.join() for i in self.prescrape_threads]
181 | 		else: self.scrapers_dialog()
182 | 		return self.prescrape_sources

184 | 	def process_results(self, results):
185 | 		if self.prescrape: self.all_scrapers = self.active_internal_scrapers
186 | 		else:
187 | 			self.all_scrapers = list(set(self.active_internal_scrapers + self.remove_scrapers))
188 | 			clear_property('fs_filterless_search')
189 | 		self.uncached_results = self.sort_results([i for i in results if 'Uncached' in i.get('cache_provider', '')])
190 | 		results = [i for i in results if not i in self.uncached_results]
191 | 		if self.ignore_scrape_filters:
192 | 			self.filters_ignored = True
193 | 			results = self.sort_results(results)
194 | 		else:
195 | 			results = self.sort_results(results)
196 | 			results = self.filter_results(results)
197 | 			results = self.filter_audio(results)
198 | 			for file_type in filter_keys: results = self.special_filter(results, file_type)
199 | 		results = self.sort_preferred_autoplay(results)
200 | 		results = self.sort_preferred_language(results)
201 | 		results = self.sort_first(results)
202 | 		return results
203 | 
204 | 	def sort_results(self, results):
205 | 		for item in results:
206 | 			provider = item['scrape_provider']
207 | 			if provider == 'external': account_type = item['debrid'].lower()
208 | 			else: account_type = provider.lower()
209 | 			item['provider_rank'] = self._get_provider_rank(account_type)
210 | 			item['quality_rank'] = self._get_quality_rank(item.get('quality', 'SD'))
211 | 		results.sort(key=self.sort_function)
212 | 		results = self._sort_uncached_results(results)
213 | 		return results
214 | 
215 | 	def filter_results(self, results):
216 | 		if self.folders_ignore_filters:
217 | 			folder_results = [i for i in results if i['scrape_provider'] == 'folders']
218 | 			results = [i for i in results if not i in folder_results]
219 | 		else: folder_results = []
220 | 		results = [i for i in results if i['quality'] in self.quality_filter]
221 | 		if self.filter_size_method:
222 | 			min_size = string_to_float(get_setting('fenlight.results.%s_size_min' % self.media_type, '0'), '0') / 1000
223 | 			if min_size == 0.0 and not self.include_unknown_size: min_size = 0.02
224 | 			if self.filter_size_method == 1:
225 | 				duration = self.meta['duration'] or (5400 if self.media_type == 'movie' else 2400)
226 | 				max_size = ((0.125 * (0.90 * string_to_float(get_setting('results.line_speed', '25'), '25'))) * duration)/1000
227 | 			elif self.filter_size_method == 2:
228 | 				max_size = string_to_float(get_setting('fenlight.results.%s_size_max' % self.media_type, '10000'), '10000') / 1000
229 | 			results = [i for i in results if i['scrape_provider'] == 'folders' or min_size <= i['size'] <= max_size]
230 | 		results += folder_results
231 | 		return results
232 | 
233 | 	def filter_audio(self, results):
234 | 		return [i for i in results if not any(x in i['extraInfo'] for x in audio_filters())]
235 | 
236 | 	def special_filter(self, results, file_type):
237 | 		enable_setting, key = filter_status(file_type), filter_keys[file_type]
238 | 		if key == '[B]HEVC[/B]' and enable_setting == 0:
239 | 			hevc_max_quality = self._get_quality_rank(get_setting('fenlight.filter.hevc.%s' % ('max_autoplay_quality' if self.autoplay else 'max_quality'), '4K'))
240 | 			results = [i for i in results if not key in i['extraInfo'] or i['quality_rank'] >= hevc_max_quality]
241 | 		if enable_setting == 1:
242 | 			if key == '[B]D/VISION[/B]' and filter_status('hdr') == 0:
243 | 				results = [i for i in results if all(x in i['extraInfo'] for x in (key, '[B]HDR[/B]')) or not key in i['extraInfo']]
244 | 			else: results = [i for i in results if not key in i['extraInfo']]
245 | 		return results
246 | 
247 | 	def sort_first(self, results):
248 | 		try:
249 | 			sort_first_scrapers = []
250 | 			if 'folders' in self.all_scrapers and sort_to_top('folders'): sort_first_scrapers.append('folders')
251 | 			sort_first_scrapers.extend([i for i in self.all_scrapers if i in cloud_scrapers and sort_to_top(i)])
252 | 			if not sort_first_scrapers: return results
253 | 			sort_first = [i for i in results if i['scrape_provider'] in sort_first_scrapers]
254 | 			sort_first.sort(key=lambda k: (self._sort_folder_to_top(k['scrape_provider']), k['quality_rank']))
255 | 			sort_last = [i for i in results if not i in sort_first]
256 | 			results = sort_first + sort_last
257 | 		except: pass
258 | 		return results
259 | 
260 | 	def sort_preferred_autoplay(self, results):
261 | 		if not self.autoplay: return results
262 | 		try:
263 | 			preferences = preferred_autoplay()
264 | 			if not preferences: return results
265 | 			preference_results = [i for i in results if any(x in i['extraInfo'] for x in preferences)]
266 | 			if not preference_results: return results
267 | 			results = [i for i in results if not i in preference_results]
268 | 			preference_results = sorted([dict(item, **{'pref_includes': sum([preference_values[preferences.index(x)] for x in [i for i in preferences if i in item['extraInfo']]])}) \
269 | 						for item in preference_results], key=lambda k: k['pref_includes'], reverse=True)
270 | 			return preference_results + results
271 | 		except: return results
272 | 
273 | 	def sort_preferred_language(self, results):
274 | 		try:
275 | 			import re
276 | 			lang = preferred_language()
277 | 			if not lang: return results
278 | 			pattern = re.compile(r'(?<![a-z])' + re.escape(lang) + r'(?![a-z])')
279 | 			lang_results = [i for i in results if pattern.search(i.get('name', '').lower())]
280 | 			if not lang_results: return results
281 | 			return lang_results + [i for i in results if i not in lang_results]
282 | 		except: return results
283 | 
284 | 	def prepare_internal_scrapers(self):
285 | 		if self.active_external and len(self.active_internal_scrapers) == 1: return
286 | 		active_internal_scrapers = [i for i in self.active_internal_scrapers if not i in self.remove_scrapers]
287 | 		if self.prescrape and not self.active_external and all([check_prescrape_sources(i, self.media_type) for i in active_internal_scrapers]): return False
288 | 		if 'folders' in active_internal_scrapers:
289 | 			self.folder_info = [i for i in self.get_folderscraper_info() if source_folders_directory(self.media_type, i[1])]
290 | 			if self.folder_info:
291 | 				self.active_folders = True
292 | 				self.internal_scraper_names = [i for i in active_internal_scrapers if not i == 'folders'] + [i[0] for i in self.folder_info]
293 | 			else: self.internal_scraper_names = [i for i in active_internal_scrapers if not i == 'folders']
294 | 		else:
295 | 			self.folder_info = []
296 | 			self.internal_scraper_names = active_internal_scrapers[:]
297 | 		self.active_internal_scrapers = active_internal_scrapers
298 | 		if self.clear_properties: self._clear_properties()
299 | 		return True

305 | 		else: self.sources.extend(sources)

370 | 	def scrapers_dialog(self):
371 | 		def _scraperDialog():
372 | 			monitor = xbmc_monitor()
373 | 			start_time = time.time()
374 | 			while not self.progress_dialog.iscanceled() and not monitor.abortRequested():
375 | 				try:
376 | 					remaining_providers = [x.getName() for x in _threads if x.is_alive() is True]
377 | 					self._process_internal_results()
378 | 					current_progress = max((time.time() - start_time), 0)
379 | 					line1 = ', '.join(remaining_providers).upper()
380 | 					percent = int((current_progress/float(scraper_timeout))*100)
381 | 					self.progress_dialog.update_scraper(self.sources_sd, self.sources_720p, self.sources_1080p, self.sources_4k, self.sources_total, line1, percent)
382 | 					sleep(self.sleep_time)
383 | 					if len(remaining_providers) == 0: break
384 | 					if percent >= 100: break
385 | 				except:	return self._kill_progress_dialog()
386 | 		if self.prescrape: scraper_list, _threads = self.prescrape_scrapers, self.prescrape_threads
387 | 		else: scraper_list, _threads = self.providers, self.threads
388 | 		self.internal_scrapers = self._get_active_scraper_names(scraper_list)
389 | 		if not self.internal_scrapers: return
390 | 		_scraperDialog()
391 | 		try: del monitor
392 | 		except: pass

394 | 	def display_results(self, results):
395 | 		window_format, window_number = results_format()
396 | 		action, chosen_item = open_window(('windows.sources', 'SourcesResults'), 'sources_results.xml',
397 | 				window_format=window_format, window_id=window_number, results=results, meta=self.meta, episode_group_label=self.episode_group_label,
398 | 				scraper_settings=self.scraper_settings, prescrape=self.prescrape, filters_ignored=self.filters_ignored, uncached_results=self.uncached_results)
399 | 		if not action: self._kill_progress_dialog()
400 | 		elif action == 'play': return self.play_file(results, chosen_item)
401 | 		elif self.prescrape and action == 'perform_full_search':
402 | 			self.prescrape, self.clear_properties = False, False
403 | 			return self.get_sources()

405 | 	def _get_active_scraper_names(self, scraper_list):
406 | 		return [i[2] for i in scraper_list]

408 | 	def _process_post_results(self):
409 | 		if self.auto_rescrape_with_all in (1, 2) and self.active_external and not self.rescrape_with_all:
410 | 			self.rescrape_with_all = True
411 | 			if self.auto_rescrape_with_all == 1 or confirm_dialog(heading=self.meta.get('rootname', ''), text='No results.[CR]Retry With All Scrapers?'):
412 | 				self.threads, self.disabled_ext_ignored, self.prescrape = [], True, False
413 | 				return self.get_sources()
414 | 		if self.media_type == 'episode' and self.auto_episode_group in (1, 2) and not self.rescrape_with_episode_group:
415 | 			self.rescrape_with_episode_group = True
416 | 			if self.auto_episode_group == 1 or confirm_dialog(heading=self.meta.get('rootname', ''), text='No results.[CR]Retry With Custom Episode Group if Possible?'):
417 | 				if self.episode_group_used:

233 | def sec2time(sec, n_msec=3):
234 | 	''' Convert seconds to 'D days, HH:MM:SS.FFF' '''
235 | 	if hasattr(sec,'__len__'): return [sec2time(s) for s in sec]
236 | 	m, s = divmod(sec, 60)
237 | 	h, m = divmod(m, 60)
238 | 	d, h = divmod(h, 24)
239 | 	if n_msec > 0: pattern = '%%02d:%%02d:%%0%d.%df' % (n_msec+3, n_msec)
240 | 	else: pattern = '%02d:%02d:%02d'
241 | 	if d == 0: return pattern % (h, m, s)
242 | 	return ('%d days, ' + pattern) % (d, h, m, s)

408 |         if not items:

413 |             x = Dialog().select(header, items, useDetails=bool(use_details))

139 |         tmdb_type = 'episode' if episode is not None else 'season'
140 |     return _convert_types('tmdb', tmdb_type, output)
